rows.title: Business Analyst
rows.description:
Are you a Business Analyst with experience in payroll, HR, or large-scale process change? We’re partnering with an aerospace organization in Plainville, Connecticut, to find a professional who can support an important payroll transformation initiative.
In this role, you’ll help evaluate current payroll operations, gather and define business requirements, and support the transition from a semi-monthly payroll cycle to a bi-weekly arrears schedule. You’ll work closely with payroll, HR, finance, and other cross-functional teams to help ensure the change is efficient, compliant, and well-coordinated.
What You’ll Do
Review current payroll processes to identify workflow gaps, risks, and dependencies related to the payroll schedule change.
Partner with payroll, human resources, finance, and other stakeholders to gather and document business requirements.
Help translate business needs into practical process improvements that support the move to a bi-weekly arrears payroll structure.
Review policies, procedures, and supporting documentation to ensure consistency, accuracy, and compliance.
Facilitate conversations across teams, including customer service or call center contacts when employee communication support is needed.
Support Agile project activities by helping clarify priorities, refine requirements, and contribute to sprint discussions.
Develop process maps, impact assessments, and gap analyses to support implementation planning.
Participate in testing, issue tracking, and validation efforts to support a successful rollout.
Benefits available to contract/temporary professionals, include medical, vision, dental, and life and disability insurance. Hired contract/temporary professionals are also eligible to enroll in our company 401(k) plan. Visit roberthalf.gobenefits.net for more information.

• Experience in business analysis with a strong ability to gather requirements and document end-to-end processes.
• Knowledge of payroll-related operations and the business impacts of changes to pay cycles or pay administration.
• Ability to perform gap analysis and turn findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
• Experience reviewing business documentation, policies, or operational records with a high level of accuracy.
• Familiarity with Agile Scrum environments and collaboration within iterative project teams.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively across HR, finance, payroll, and service-oriented teams.
• Analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a structured manner.

rows.title: Business Analyst
rows.description:
We are looking for a Business Analyst to support project portfolio coordination and reporting for a large education environment in Cambridge, Massachusetts. This Long-term Contract position is ideal for someone who can independently drive weekly reporting cycles, bring structure to a high-volume project pipeline, and keep project stakeholders aligned on priorities and status. The role will work closely with project managers and IT leaders to produce clear updates, organize incoming demand, and strengthen visibility across active initiatives.
Responsibilities:
• Create and maintain clear, executive-ready reports that summarize portfolio status, project changes, risks, and upcoming milestones for recurring leadership meetings.
• Coordinate with a group of project managers to gather updates, confirm progress, and ensure portfolio information remains accurate and current.
• Organize and track a large pipeline of technology-related requests and active initiatives submitted by departments, schools, labs, and community stakeholders.
• Extract and analyze data from ServiceNow, Excel, Google Sheets, and related financial sources to support portfolio oversight and operational reporting.
• Facilitate weekly reporting processes by preparing materials, following up on open items, and helping keep projects moving against agreed timelines.
• Partner with IT leadership and project teams to improve visibility into projects in flight, new requests, and changing priorities across the organization.
• Prepare presentation materials and reporting summaries in PowerPoint for leadership discussions and decision-making forums.
• Contribute to project portfolio administration for a broad range of IT initiatives, which may include infrastructure efforts, enterprise software implementations, security-related work, and other institutional technology projects.
• Support portfolio reporting activities tied to evolving tools or systems when needed as part of ongoing project responsibilities.

• 5+ years of experience in business analysis, project portfolio support, PMO coordination, or a closely related function.
• Hands-on experience using ServiceNow in a project or portfolio management environment.
• Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills, including the ability to organize, analyze, and present data from multiple sources.
• Experience working with financial data or financial systems in support of reporting, planning, or project tracking.
• Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with project managers, stakeholders, and senior leaders across cross-functional teams.
• Proficiency in PowerPoint for developing high-quality reporting decks and leadership presentations.
• Ability to work independently, manage recurring reporting deadlines, and drive follow-through with minimal supervision.
• Background supporting IT organizations, project portfolios, or enterprise technology initiatives is strongly preferred.

rows.title: Business Analyst
rows.description:
We are looking for a Business Analyst to join a fast-moving advisory environment in New York, where you will contribute to high-impact transaction and strategic projects across healthcare and technology. This position offers close collaboration with senior executives, founders, and investors while providing meaningful exposure to mergers and acquisitions, capital raising efforts, and market intelligence work. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical judgment, effective communication skills, and the ability to manage several priorities with a high degree of independence.
Responsibilities:
• Contribute to merger, acquisition, and fundraising engagements through each stage of the deal lifecycle, from initial planning to closing activities.
• Join discussions with client leadership, including founders, chief executives, and investors, to capture priorities and support transaction progress.
• Create clear briefing documents, presentation materials, and other decision-support content for client and investor audiences.
• Develop and update lists of prospective buyers, investors, and strategic targets to support outreach and transaction strategy.
• Assist with due diligence coordination by organizing information, monitoring requests, and helping move execution workstreams forward.
• Review financial forecasts provided by clients and refine Excel-based models to support analysis and scenario evaluation.
• Monitor active opportunities, transaction timelines, and key milestones to help maintain visibility across multiple concurrent projects.
• Perform industry, market, and competitive research using modern AI-enabled tools, including Claude, to produce relevant business insights.
• Deliver client-ready materials in PowerPoint and other formats while balancing multiple assignments with minimal day-to-day supervision.

• At least 2 years of experience in business analysis, consulting, transaction support, strategic finance, due diligence, or a related analytical function.
• Strong Excel capabilities with the ability to interpret financial projections and work confidently within structured models.
• Demonstrated experience preparing clear, effective presentations using PowerPoint for business or client-facing settings.
• Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to interact effectively with executives and external stakeholders.
• Familiarity with AI-supported research platforms, including Claude or similar tools, for gathering and synthesizing information.
• Proven ability to stay organized, manage competing deadlines, and perform well in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment.
• Self-directed work style with the judgment to move projects forward independently while maintaining quality and responsiveness.
• Interest in healthcare, technology, startups, venture capital, or M&A-related work is strongly preferred.

• Evaluate documents and business records for accuracy, completeness, and alignment with operational and compliance expectations.

rows.title: Business Analyst
rows.description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support a long-term contract opportunity. This role is ideal for someone who can evaluate complex datasets, identify inconsistencies, and help prepare information for accurate use in future-state business processes. The position requires strong financial acumen, analytical thinking, and the ability to interpret how data elements connect across multiple business entities and operational workflows.
Responsibilities:
• Analyze and refine large volumes of business data to improve quality, consistency, and readiness for downstream use.
• Examine data across multiple entities and systems to identify mismatches, overlaps, and gaps that affect reporting and operational accuracy.
• Partner with stakeholders to define which data elements should be retained, standardized, and aligned with business objectives.
• Review legacy automated processing rules and assess how those behaviors influence current data workflows and future process performance.
• Document findings, data issues, and business rules clearly to support decision-making and cross-functional collaboration.
• Perform gap analysis to uncover discrepancies between existing data structures and target business requirements.
• Support Agile team activities by helping translate business needs into actionable analysis and documentation.
• Apply financial understanding to evaluate company codes, transactional data, and other finance-related records for accuracy and usability.

• Proven experience in business analysis with a strong focus on data cleansing, data review, or data quality initiatives.
• Hands-on understanding of SAP ECC and related enterprise data environments.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets across multiple business functions.
• Knowledge of financial data concepts and the ability to assess finance-related records and structures.
• Experience evaluating automated data processing logic and its impact on end-to-end workflows.
• Familiarity with Agile Scrum methods and working within collaborative project teams.
• Ability to perform gap analysis and produce clear, organized business and data documentation.

rows.title: Business Analyst
rows.description:
Robert Half is seeking a
Business Process Analyst
to support a mid-sized professional services organization with approximately 200 employees. This individual will focus on documenting, evaluating, and standardizing business processes to improve workflow consistency, data quality, and overall operational efficiency. Apply today!
This role will primarily focus on business process analysis and standardization (approximately 60%), with the remaining focus on business requirements and supporting an upcoming CRM implementation (approximately 40%).
Duration:
3 to 6 month contract
Location:
100% Remote
Schedule:
Monday – Friday 8 to 5pm (Flexible)
Responsibilities
Evaluate and document existing business processes, workflows, and procedures across the organization.
Develop current-state (as-is) and future-state (to-be) process maps and documentation.
Identify process gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities to improve standardization and operational efficiency.
Recommend and establish new workflows that support consistent business practices and improve data quality.
Work with stakeholders to understand how information is captured, maintained, and transferred throughout business processes.
Identify workflow triggers, business events, and required next steps to ensure processes are completed consistently.
Help address common data quality issues, including missing information, outdated records, and inconsistent data entry.
Collaborate with stakeholders across Architecture, Design, Operations, Client Services, Finance, HR, IT, and Marketing/Business Development.
Provide process analysis, requirements gathering, and design support for an upcoming CRM implementation.
Develop practical process documentation, guidelines, and checklists that employees can follow.

Experience as a Business Process Analyst, Business Analyst, or in a similar process improvement-focused role.
Experience documenting, evaluating, and standardizing business processes and workflows.
Ability to develop current-state and future-state process documentation and recommend improvements.
Experience working directly with stakeholders to understand existing processes and establish new workflows.
Comfortable working in a smaller, less structured environment where processes may be ambiguous or not fully defined.
Strong understanding of how business processes impact data consistency, accuracy, and quality.
Ability to take a practical, right-sized approach to process improvement rather than introducing unnecessary complexity.
Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working within a professional services organization.
Background in Architecture, Design, or a related industry.
Experience supporting CRM implementations or working with CRM modules within an ERP system.
Exposure to Marketing and Business Development processes.

rows.title: Business Analyst III - Salesforce
rows.description:
Robert Half
, one of FORTUNE's World's Most Admired Companies and a Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For, is seeking a

to join the ATI Salesforce Competency Center. This role serves as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions while driving process improvements across the organization.
What You'll Do

Facilitate discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews, workshops, and requirements documentation.
Partner with business leaders, IT teams, and vendors to evaluate solutions, perform fit-gap analyses, and recommend improvements.
Document business processes, workflows, user journeys, and system requirements.
Assess impacts to current and future business processes, including upstream and downstream dependencies.
Serve as a liaison between business stakeholders, technical teams, and field locations.
Develop reports, dashboards, and insights that support data-driven decision-making.
Facilitate stakeholder meetings, training sessions, and change management activities.
Support process optimization initiatives and identify opportunities to leverage Salesforce capabilities.
Perform basic configuration in non-production environments to demonstrate potential solutions.
Mentor team members and act as a trusted advisor, aligning business objectives with technical solutions.

Associate degree, certification, or equivalent professional experience.
5+ years of business analysis experience supporting enterprise applications.
Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and Agile delivery.
Experience gathering, documenting, and validating business requirements.
Ability to create process flows, workflow diagrams, and functional documentation.
Knowledge of Salesforce and the ability to align platform capabilities with business needs.
Experience conducting fit-gap analysis and supporting medium to large-scale initiatives.
Strong reporting, query, and analytical skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to influence stakeholders, facilitate discussions, and drive work to completion.
Experience managing multiple priorities and project deliverables in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Salesforce Administrator Certification and/or Salesforce Business Analyst Certification.
Experience with Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud.
Experience facilitating discovery workshops and requirements sessions.

rows.title: Business Systems Analyst (Fiserv)
rows.description:

Salary:  $100,000 - $130,000 base + exceptional benefits

A growing financial institution is seeking a Senior Business Systems Analyst to play a critical role supporting and optimizing its core banking environment. This position is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of banking operations, technology, system administration, and process improvement.
You'll serve as a key owner of the bank's mission-critical core banking platform, partnering with business leaders, IT teams, compliance stakeholders, and technology vendors to drive reliability, efficiency, security, and continuous improvement.
What You'll Do
• Administer and support a core banking platform and related business systems (Precision by Fiserv and other related applications)
• Manage system configuration, user security, access controls, and daily operations
• Lead testing, upgrades, releases, and change management initiatives
• Troubleshoot system issues and coordinate resolutions with internal teams and vendors
• Support system integrations and third-party banking applications
• Identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and process improvement
• Partner with Audit, Compliance, and business stakeholders to maintain regulatory readiness
What We're Looking For
• 6+ years of experience supporting banking systems or core banking platforms (Precision by Fiserv and other related applications)
• Experience with core banking administration, configuration, and system support
• Knowledge of deposits, loans, user security, product setup, and operational workflows
• Experience with system upgrades, release testing, and vendor management
• Understanding of banking regulations, audits, and compliance requirements
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and process improvement skills
What Makes Someone Successful
• Self-starter with an ownership mentality
• Naturally curious problem solver
• Brings solutions, not just issues
• Comfortable working independently while collaborating across teams
• Passionate about improving processes and driving operational excellence
Location
Hybrid opportunity with flexibility for remote work. Candidates should be located within driving distance of the office for occasional onsite meetings and collaboration.
If you're a banking technology professional looking to make a measurable impact on critical systems while working with an organization that values stability, innovation, and continuous improvement, we'd love to connect.
*** For immediate and confidential consideration, please APPLY and EMAIL YOUR RESUME to MEREDITH CARLE .  My email can be found on my LinkedIn page.  Also, you may contact me at 515-303-4654.  Or one click apply on our Robert Half website.  No third party inquiries please.  Our client cannot provide sponsorship and cannot hire C2C. ***

Business Analysis, Fiserv, Banking Industry, Application administration, Application configuration, Role-based access control, System Integration Testing, System Integration, Support system integration

rows.title: AI/Data Governance Analyst
rows.description:
We are looking for an experienced AI/Data Governance Program Lead to help strengthen responsible AI practices within a financial services environment in San Diego, California. This position works closely with technology, security, legal, and risk stakeholders to create practical governance for AI platforms, large language models, and automated decision-support tools. The role is ideal for someone who can translate evolving regulatory expectations into clear controls that support innovation while protecting the business.
Responsibilities:
• Design and refine governance frameworks, policy standards, and review processes that guide the responsible use of AI across the organization.
• Assess internally developed and externally sourced AI solutions to identify concerns related to security, privacy, compliance, and operational risk.
• Oversee a centralized record of AI tools and use cases, ensuring approved implementations remain visible, current, and properly governed.
• Define control measures for employee-created AI solutions, including expectations for data access, retention, and acceptable content handling.
• Partner with audit, risk, and control teams to address identified weaknesses, strengthen oversight, and communicate program status to leadership.
• Provide practical guidance to business teams on responsible AI adoption and adjust governance approaches as technologies and regulations continue to change.
• Contribute to risk assessments involving model governance, data governance, and architecture governance for AI-enabled initiatives.

• 7+ years of experience in technology governance, risk management, compliance, cybersecurity, data governance, or AI-related oversight functions.
• Working knowledge of responsible AI frameworks, AI governance standards, and emerging control expectations relevant to regulated environments.
• Understanding of data protection practices, vendor risk reviews, change management processes, and technology control frameworks.
• Ability to evaluate technical risk and communicate findings in a clear, business-focused manner to cross-functional stakeholders.
• Experience supporting governance activities involving AI tools, large language models, or automated decision technologies.
• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or an equivalent combination of education and practical experience.
• Familiarity with skills such as Microsoft SQL, data analysis, risk assessments, model governance, project governance, or master data governance is valued.
• Certifications related to governance, risk, security, audit, or compliance are preferred.

rows.title: Sr Business Systems Analyst (Pigment)
rows.description:
We are looking for a Senior Business Systems Analyst (NetSuite) to lead and optimize enterprise planning capabilities in San Francisco, California. This position works closely with Finance, FP&A, Supply Chain, and Technology teams to shape scalable planning solutions, strengthen system performance, and support informed business decisions. The role combines platform ownership, cross-functional collaboration, and process improvement to help teams plan more effectively and operate with greater consistency.
Responsibilities:
• Serve as the primary administrator for the Pigment platform, overseeing configuration, user access, security settings, testing activities, and production releases.
• Design, enhance, and maintain planning models that support financial forecasting, workforce planning, operating expenses, capital investments, and supply chain planning processes.
• Partner with business stakeholders to convert operational and financial planning needs into system solutions, ensuring models reflect accurate logic, assumptions, and approval flows.
• Coordinate with data and architecture teams to support integrations between Pigment and connected source systems, while resolving data flow issues and maintaining reliable information exchange.
• Establish and manage structured change control practices, including impact reviews, approval tracking, release documentation, and audit-ready records.
• Act as a key escalation point for platform-related issues, driving troubleshooting efforts and helping users resolve functional challenges efficiently.
• Create training materials, user guides, and internal documentation that promote adoption, improve self-service capabilities, and reduce reliance on ad hoc support.
• Identify opportunities to expand platform functionality by evaluating new features, recommending enhancements, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives across planning operations.

• 7+ years of experience in business systems analysis, financial systems, FP&A technology, or a related techno-functional role.
• Practical experience with Pigment, Anaplan, Workday Adaptive, Planful, or similar enterprise planning platforms, including administration or model configuration.
• Strong understanding of financial planning concepts such as budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, headcount planning, operating expenses, capital planning, and financial modeling.
• Familiarity with supply chain planning principles, including demand forecasting, inventory management, supply balancing, and sales and operations planning.
• Working knowledge of system integrations, data mapping, flat-file or cloud-based data exchanges, and connections with enterprise data platforms or warehouses.
• Experience gathering requirements, reviewing documentation, and working with cross-functional teams in Agile or iterative delivery environments.
• Ability to troubleshoot system and data issues, communicate clearly with technical and business partners, and translate complex requirements into practical solutions.

rows.title: Project Manager
rows.description:
We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead complex, enterprise-level initiatives that support operational performance and business objectives. This Long-term Contract position is ideal for a detail-oriented individual who can guide projects from initial planning through final delivery while coordinating across stakeholders, vendors, and internal teams. The role calls for strong leadership, sound judgment, and the ability to drive process improvements, manage project outcomes, and encourage successful adoption of change.
Responsibilities:
• Direct large-scale and high-complexity projects from kickoff through completion, ensuring objectives, timelines, budgets, and quality standards remain aligned with stakeholder expectations.
• Prepare and maintain core project documentation, including schedules, staffing plans, financial tracking, status updates, performance measures, and related delivery materials.
• Lead the execution of process enhancements and operational improvements required to achieve intended business results.
• Partner with key stakeholders to support change readiness through impact assessments, communication planning, training coordination, and adoption tracking.
• Define stakeholder involvement across each initiative by identifying decision-makers, subject matter experts, and team responsibilities early in the project lifecycle.
• Build strong working relationships with sponsors, business leaders, technical teams, customers, and project peers to shape delivery strategies and resolve issues effectively.
• Monitor project risks, barriers, and performance trends using both qualitative feedback and quantitative data, then take timely corrective action when needed.
• Coach and support project team members by providing guidance, performance feedback, and development opportunities that strengthen collaboration and results.
• Conduct post-launch evaluations to capture lessons learned, share outcomes with teams, and improve future project delivery practices.
• Review vendor execution and service quality, escalating concerns when performance does not meet expectations.

• Demonstrated experience managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders, broad scope, and high business impact.
• Strong knowledge of project planning, budgeting, reporting, resource coordination, and delivery oversight.
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence decision-making, and build alignment across business and technical groups.
• Experience supporting organizational change through communication, training, and stakeholder engagement efforts.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint for reporting, analysis, presentations, and project documentation.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present updates clearly to leadership and project teams.
• Ability to evaluate data, identify delivery obstacles, and implement practical solutions in a timely manner.
• Experience working with external vendors and managing service expectations, performance reviews, and escalations as needed.

rows.title: Senior Project Manager

rows.title: Infrastructure Project Manager
rows.description:
We are looking for an Infrastructure Project Manager to oversee technology initiatives that support enterprise infrastructure operations in San Antonio, Texas. This role is ideal for a project leader who can coordinate cross-functional teams, manage competing priorities, and keep complex technical efforts moving from planning through delivery. The successful candidate will bring a strong foundation in infrastructure environments, effective communication skills, and the ability to guide projects using structured delivery methods.
Responsibilities:
• Lead infrastructure-focused projects from initiation through completion, ensuring scope, schedule, budget, and quality targets are met.
• Coordinate technical teams, business stakeholders, and external vendors to drive progress across multiple concurrent initiatives.
• Build and maintain project plans, status reporting, risk logs, and portfolio documentation using established project management platforms.
• Apply both agile and traditional delivery approaches based on project needs, team structure, and implementation complexity.
• Oversee work related to network environments, data center infrastructure, enterprise systems, and structured cabling efforts.

rows.title: Project Manager/Sr. Consultant
rows.description:
Robert Half's enterprise client is looking for an experienced Security Analyst Consultant with a strong security mindset who enjoys uncovering insights, connecting dots, and answering questions before they're asked. This Long-term Contract position is based in Redmond, Washington, and will focus on restoring data reliability, improving reporting visibility, and strengthening integration with Power BI. The ideal candidate brings a strong mix of project leadership, technical problem-solving, and reporting expertise to help build a more dependable and scalable operational data foundation.
Responsibilities:
Support threat/security analysis by querying security-related data and identifying potential risks, anomalies, or areas that need further investigation.
Analyze existing datasets using SQL, Python, and/or KQL.
Go beyond simply returning query results by asking follow-up security questions and investigating what the data may indicate.
Cross-reference internal security/access data with other sources, including open-source government risk/ban lists.
Analyze data center access information to identify unusual or potentially inappropriate access patterns.
Help identify gaps and edge cases in existing security controls, such as name variations that may bypass exact-match screening.
Develop Power BI reports to support security analysis and reporting.
Work with the data engineering team when additional datasets need to be brought into the environment or when analysis requires engineering support.
Clearly define analytical/security requirements so data engineers can build the appropriate technical solution.
Work closely with the security team to investigate findings and engage the appropriate teams when an issue needs to be addressed.
Soft skills:
Security-minded first. This was the most important requirement for the role.
Naturally curious and investigative. Should see a finding and immediately think about what additional questions or data should be explored.
Able to think independently rather than relying on the security lead to determine every next step.
Comfortable questioning results and looking for edge cases or weaknesses in existing controls.
Able to communicate findings clearly and work with security, data engineering, and other relevant teams to resolve issues.
Comfortable working very closely with the security lead throughout the day.
Must be based in the Americas to align with the team and working hours.

Strong data-querying skills, particularly SQL and/or Python. KQL is also relevant.
Comfortable working with large security-related datasets and investigating relationships across multiple data sources.
Power BI experience for reporting and visualization.
Ability to develop queries that identify anomalies, exceptions, or patterns requiring further investigation.
Able to understand and articulate analytical requirements, even when implementation requires support from a data engineer.

rows.title: Project Manager - Operations
rows.description:

Establish AI ownership, decision rights, approval processes, and risk controls.
Identify, prioritize, and build business cases for high-value AI use cases.
Evaluate AI platforms including Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI, Claude, and related technologies.

Partner with executive leadership, IT, Operations, HR, Finance, and business unit leaders to drive enterprise adoption.

AI Maturity Assessment
Enterprise AI Governance Framework
AI Acceptable Use Policy

Executive AI Strategy and Investment Recommendations

8+ years leading digital transformation, automation, AI, or business transformation initiatives.
AI PM experience - must have
Former Accenture AI Strategy, or Big4 - Deloitte AI Transformation, PWC AI Advisor experience
Former Copilot Adoption or AI Program Lead
Experience developing AI strategies and governance programs.
Strong understanding of Generative AI, AI risk management, and enterprise adoption.
Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders and lead cross-functional initiatives.

• Strong knowledge of generative AI capabilities, enterprise AI platforms, and risk considerations tied to adoption and oversight.

3+ years of experience managing projects across multiple departments.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including clear meeting minutes and concise updates for leadership.
Experience with Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Planner or a similar project tracking tool.

Experience supporting administrative operations, procurement, or facilities projects is a plus.

rows.title: Sr Project Manager
rows.description:
We are looking for an experienced Sr Project Manager to lead digital initiatives and keep cross-functional work moving efficiently in Washington, District of Columbia. This Long-term Contract position is ideal for someone who is detail oriented and can organize complex project plans, align stakeholders, and maintain momentum across multiple priorities. rows.title: Senior Project Controls Manager Data Center Construction
rows.description:
Chris Preble from Robert Half is working with a data center client of his that is massively growing. This 250MW project is providing for a newly created Sr Project Controls Manager to join the team. The role will involve travel to Texas and other locations in the future. You'll be on site a few days a week and remote other times...depending on what's going on.
Must have - Controls ownership on at least one campus or program of roughly 100 MW or greater.
Here are the details:
We are hiring a
Senior Project Controls Manager
to own the master schedule and project cost for our hyperscale data center developments, from pre-construction through commissioning and turnover. You will report to our Senior Project Manager and work closely with our SVP of Operations as the owner's controls lead on each project.
This is not a reporting role. You will build the Primavera P6 master schedule, own the budget and forecast, and tell leadership what the numbers mean: where the project stands, where it is heading and what we need to do about it. You will hold the General Contractor, Owner's Engineer and trade partners to their schedule and cost commitments.
Key Responsibilities
Master Schedule Ownership
Develop and own the integrated master schedule (IMS) in Primavera P6, covering design, permitting, utility power, procurement, construction, commissioning and turnover.
Set the schedule baseline, work breakdown structure (WBS) and milestone framework for each project.
Review, challenge and approve GC and trade schedules; integrate them into the owner's master schedule.
Run critical path, float and schedule risk analysis; flag slippage early and drive recovery plans with the Senior PM.
Track long-lead equipment (generators, switchgear, transformers, UPS, chillers, CDUs) from order to delivery against need dates.
Evaluate time impact analyses and delay claims from contractors.
Cost Ownership
Own the project budget from approval through closeout, including commitments, actuals, forecasts and contingency.
Build and maintain estimate-at-completion (EAC) and cash flow forecasts.
Evaluate change orders, pay applications and claims for cost and schedule impact before approval.
Apply earned value management (EVM) to measure cost and schedule performance.
Support bid leveling and contract award with cost benchmarks ($/MW) from comparable projects.
Analysis and Reporting
Build the reports, dashboards and models, not just read them.
Turn schedule and cost data into a clear point of view: what is happening, why, and what we should do.
Deliver monthly project health reports to executive leadership, investors and lenders.
Set up project controls standards, templates and tools that scale across multiple campuses.
Partnership with the Senior Project Manager
Serve as the Senior PM's counterpart on all schedule, cost and risk decisions.
Lead schedule and cost reviews with the GC, Owner's Engineer and trade partners.
Maintain the project risk register and track mitigation actions.

Required Qualifications
Data center experience:
5+ years of progressive project controls experience on large-scale, mission-critical data center projects.
Hyperscale scale:
Controls ownership on at least one campus or program of roughly 100 MW or greater.
Owner-side experience:
Direct experience working for an owner, developer, hyperscaler or owner's representative firm, not only on the contractor side.
Primavera P6 expertise:
Advanced, hands-on P6 skills, including building master schedules from scratch, logic and WBS design, baselining, resource and cost loading, critical path and float analysis, and schedule recovery.
Cost control:
Proven ownership of budgets, commitments, forecasts, EAC, cash flow and contingency on projects of $500M or more.
Change and claims:
Experience evaluating change orders, time impact analyses and delay claims.
Analytical tools:
Advanced Excel skills; experience with Power BI or similar dashboards, and cost platforms such as Procore, Oracle Primavera Unifier, Ecosys or similar.
Construction knowledge:
Working understanding of data center construction sequencing and the main power and cooling systems that drive the schedule.
Field presence:
Willingness to spend the majority of working time on active job sites in Texas and other U.S. states.
Education:
Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Finance or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Preferred Qualifications
PMI-SP, AACE PSP, CCP or EVP certification.
Experience with multi-phase, multi-building greenfield campuses.
Schedule risk analysis tools such as Primavera Risk Analysis, Safran Risk or Deltek Acumen.
Familiarity with utility interconnection timelines (ERCOT or other ISOs) and their effect on the schedule.
Experience reporting to investors, lenders or joint-venture partners.
Who Thrives Here
Builders of the numbers.
You create the schedule and the cost model; you don't wait for someone to hand them to you.
Owners, not observers.
You treat every dollar and every day of schedule as your own.
Straight talkers.
You tell leadership what the data says, even when it is bad news, and come with a plan.
Fast and flexible.
You are comfortable with ambiguity, quick decisions and a hands-on, entrepreneurial pace.
Growth-minded.
You want to build your career with a growing developer and take on more scope as our portfolio expands.

rows.title: Retirement Fund Project Manager
rows.description:
We are seeking a highly organized Retirement Fund Project Manager to oversee retirement plan activities, coordinate compliance-related deliverables, and serve as a key point of contact for clients in Charlotte, North Carolina. The ideal candidate has a background in retirement plan recordkeeping and third-party administration (TPA), with hands-on knowledge of 401(k) compliance testing, Form 5500 filings, and Department of Labor reporting requirements. This role is best suited for a detail-oriented, process-driven professional who excels at organizing complex information, managing competing priorities, and maintaining strong client relationships. Advanced Excel skills are essential, and experience with FIS Relius is highly desirable.
Responsibilities
Oversee and coordinate retirement plan activities, ensuring deliverables, deadlines, and client expectations are managed effectively.
Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, addressing questions, communicating project updates, and coordinating the resolution of retirement plan issues.
Coordinate retirement plan compliance activities, including 401(k) nondiscrimination testing, annual Form 5500 filings, and other applicable regulatory reporting requirements.
Review retirement plan records, reports, and data to identify discrepancies, maintain accuracy, and ensure required deliverables are completed on time.
Partner with third-party vendors, recordkeepers, and internal stakeholders to coordinate plan activities and resolve outstanding items, leveraging external providers for routine processing and administration.
Organize and track multiple retirement plan tasks, compliance deadlines, and reporting requirements while maintaining clear documentation and follow-through.
Develop, maintain, and manipulate Excel spreadsheets to organize plan information, sort and analyze data, track deliverables, and identify discrepancies.
Support future retirement plan recordkeeping platform transition initiatives by helping organize data, coordinate project activities, and maintain continuity of client service.
Identify opportunities to improve workflows, strengthen organization, and enhance the accuracy and efficiency of retirement plan operations.

Minimum of 3 years of experience in third-party administration (TPA), specifically in the retirement space.
Working knowledge of 401(k) plans, compliance testing, Form 5500 filings, and applicable Department of Labor reporting requirements.
Excellent client communication and relationship management skills, including the ability to explain requirements, provide updates, and coordinate solutions.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including organizing data, sorting and filtering information, maintaining spreadsheets, and performing lookups.
Experience with FIS Relius or comparable retirement plan recordkeeping and administration systems is highly desirable.

rows.title: Senior Project Manager Data Center Construction
rows.description:
Chris Preble from Robert Half is working with a data center client of his that is massively growing. This 250MW project is providing for a newly created Sr Project Manager- Data Center Construction (Owners Side) to join the team. The role will involve travel to Texas and other locations in the future. You'll be on site a few days a week and remote other times...depending on what's going on.
Must have - Controls ownership on at least one campus or program of roughly 100 MW or greater.
About the Role
We are hiring a Senior Project Manager to lead our hyperscale data center developments from the owner's side, from site selection and pre-construction through construction, commissioning and turnover. You will join each project on day one and own it to the finish line.
You will be the owner's senior voice on site. You will hold the Owner's Engineer, General Contractor, MEP trades, utilities and other partners accountable to schedule, budget and quality. This role suits a hands-on builder who knows data center construction in detail and who leads by being in the field, not behind a desk.
Key Responsibilities
Owner's Representation
Serve as the owner's senior leader on site, protecting the company's financial, schedule and operational interests.
Engage from project inception: site due diligence, design development, procurement strategy and contractor selection.
Represent Banyan Oak Group with tenants, utilities, municipalities, permitting authorities and community stakeholders.
Partner and Contractor Management
Direct and challenge the Owner's Engineer, General Contractor, design firms, MEP trades and specialty consultants.
Lead RFP processes, bid leveling and contract negotiations with the commercial team.
Enforce contract terms and drive accountability for safety, quality, schedule and cost.
Schedule, Budget and Change Control
Own the project budget, forecasts and cash flow from approval through closeout.
Review critical path schedules, identify risks early and drive recovery plans.
Evaluate, negotiate and approve change orders and claims.
Manage long-lead equipment procurement (generators, switchgear, transformers, UPS, chillers, CDUs).
Cross-Functional Coordination
Align design, construction, utilities, operations and tenant teams across multiple concurrent workstreams.
Manage handoffs between phases and between construction and the operations team.
Report project health to executive leadership and investors.
Technical Quality and Commissioning
Lead constructability and design reviews with engineering teams.
Oversee QA/QC programs tailored to mission-critical electrical and mechanical systems.
Drive Level 1–5 commissioning through Integrated Systems Testing (IST) to turnover and Ready for Service.

Required Qualifications
Data center experience:
5+ years of progressive construction or project management experience on large-scale, mission-critical data center projects.
Hyperscale scale:
Hands-on leadership of at least one campus or program of roughly 100 MW or greater.
Owner-side experience:
Direct experience working for an owner, developer, hyperscaler or owner's representative firm, not only on the contractor or subcontractor side.
Construction knowledge:
Detailed understanding of data center construction sequencing, constructability reviews and fast-track or phased delivery.
Power infrastructure:
Working knowledge of medium- and high-voltage substations, utility interconnection, switchgear, generator redundancy (N+1, 2N) and UPS topologies.
Cooling infrastructure:
Working knowledge of chilled-water plants, air handling, and liquid cooling (direct-to-chip, CDUs, rear-door heat exchangers).
Project controls:
Proven command of budgets, critical path schedules (Primavera P6 or MS Project), change management and contract administration (AIA, ConsensusDocs or similar).
Field presence:
Willingness to spend the majority of working time on active job sites in Texas and other U.S. states.
Education:
Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Who Thrives Here
Builders at heart.
You would rather walk the site than read a report about it.
Owners, not observers.
You treat every dollar and every day of schedule as your own.
Fast and flexible.
You are comfortable with ambiguity, quick decisions and a hands-on, entrepreneurial pace.
Growth-minded.
You want to build your career with a growing developer and take on more scope as our portfolio expands.
Clear communicators.
You can hold a GC accountable in the morning and brief executives in the afternoon.

rows.title: Transformation Program Manager
rows.description:
We are looking for an experienced Transformation Program Manager Consultant to lead a complex supply chain and logistics initiative based in Beachwood, Ohio. This long-term part-time (20-40 hours per week) Contract position will guide a high-impact enterprise program that supports a significant share of business operations across the U.S. and Canada. The successful consultant will align cross-functional teams, external partners, and technical resources to keep delivery on schedule, control risk, and prepare the organization for a successful launch.
Responsibilities:
• Direct program execution across business teams, implementation partners, and technology vendors to maintain alignment on priorities, timelines, and expected outcomes.
• Oversee budget performance, scope control, milestone tracking, and issue resolution to keep the transformation moving forward effectively.
• Coordinate complex integration activities involving SAP-centered processes, Salesforce, logistics applications, and connected system interfaces.

• Identify delivery risks early, escalate critical concerns appropriately, and provide leadership with clear visibility into program health and dependencies.
• Hold third-party providers accountable for commitments, deliverables, and overall performance across multiple workstreams.
• Support a smooth production rollout and transition into ongoing operational support with minimal business disruption.

• 10+ years of experience leading large-scale enterprise programs, transformation initiatives, or complex technology implementations.
• Demonstrated background managing multi-vendor environments, including system integrators and specialized platform partners.
• Experience delivering projects related to supply chain, logistics, distribution, or operational transformation.
• Knowledge of SAP-focused programs or ERP-driven implementations, including integration-heavy delivery models.
• Familiarity with Salesforce implementations, connected platforms, or related interface management.
• Strong capability in budget oversight, risk management, scope governance, and executive stakeholder communication.
• Proven success guiding testing, deployment readiness, user adoption, and go-live coordination.
• Ability to work independently, influence cross-functional teams, and drive results in complex environments without direct authority.

rows.title: Marketing Jira & AI Solutions Program Manager
rows.description:
We are looking for a Marketing Jira & AI Solutions Program Manager to shape and optimize a modern work management environment for Marketing teams in San Francisco, California. This Long-term Contract position will guide the design of scalable Jira and AI-enabled solutions that improve visibility, planning, and execution across complex marketing and creative workflows. The role blends strategic program leadership with hands-on solution design, partnering with business stakeholders and engineering teams to create practical systems that support adoption, efficiency, and long-term growth.
Responsibilities:
• Design and refine a scalable Jira Cloud framework that supports marketing intake, project execution, portfolio visibility, and team capacity planning.
• Partner with Marketing, Creative Operations, and cross-functional stakeholders to gather business needs and translate them into clear technical requirements for engineering delivery.
• Define solution priorities, roadmap sequencing, and implementation plans to ensure new capabilities are delivered in a logical and high-impact order.

• Identify opportunities to apply AI-driven and automation-based capabilities to streamline request routing, triage, reporting, and operational efficiency.

• Demonstrated experience building Jira-based solutions for marketing, creative operations, or brand-focused organizations.

• Hands-on experience with AI and automation capabilities within the Atlassian ecosystem, including tools such as Rovo, Jira AI features, webhooks, and related automation technologies.
• Familiarity with integrating Jira with external platforms such as Slack, Glean, Zapier, or similar business systems through APIs and workflow automation.
• Proven ability to bridge business and technical teams by converting operational needs into actionable engineering requirements.

rows.title: Operations Manager
rows.description:
An established international manufacturer is seeking an experienced Operations Manager to oversee its U.S. operational activities. With a global manufacturing footprint and a growing North American presence, the company is looking for a hands-on, forward-thinking leader who can help strengthen operations, improve efficiencies, and support continued growth.
This individual will work closely with the U.S. Managing Director, serving as a key operational partner while taking ownership of the day-to-day activities of the local facility. The environment is a combination of light assembly, packaging, shipping, receiving, and distribution, requiring someone who is comfortable wearing multiple hats and thinking beyond the immediate task at hand.
Key Responsibilities
Oversee daily operations of the U.S. facility, including assembly, packaging, shipping, receiving, inventory, and logistics.
Identify and implement process improvements that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and support scalability.
Develop and manage relationships with domestic and international suppliers, including sourcing, negotiations, and vendor management.
Coordinate with international manufacturing partners to ensure production timelines, quality expectations, and delivery schedules are met.
Evaluate operational costs, resource allocation, and personnel needs to support business objectives.
Establish and refine operational procedures, workflows, and performance standards.
Proactively identify opportunities to improve the business and bring forward recommendations to leadership.
Collaborate with sales leadership and the broader international organization to ensure alignment between customer demand and operational capabilities.
Travel internationally as needed to visit manufacturing partners and maintain strong supplier relationships.

5+ years of experience in operations management, plant management, manufacturing, distribution, or a related environment.
Experience overseeing facility operations, logistics, inventory, shipping/receiving, or light manufacturing/assembly.
Demonstrated ability to improve processes, drive efficiencies, and manage operational costs.
Strong supplier management, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Strategic thinker who is equally comfortable managing day-to-day responsibilities and identifying opportunities for long-term improvement.
Self-starter with the ability to work independently, make sound decisions, and take ownership without significant oversight.
Strong communication and organizational skills, particularly within an international business environment.
Willingness to travel internationally at least once annually.

rows.title: Financial Operations Manager
rows.description:
We are looking for a Financial Operations Manager to strengthen financial performance and operational decision-making in Bloomington, Indiana. This role will connect plant and business leaders with timely analysis on cost, margin, inventory, and productivity trends, helping the organization improve profitability and efficiency. The ideal candidate brings strong manufacturing finance expertise, a practical approach to partnering with operations, and the ability to turn complex data into clear recommendations.
Responsibilities:
• Direct recurring financial reviews that examine cost performance, gross margin movement, and operational variances across facilities, product lines, and business segments.
• Assess manufacturing and operating metrics such as yield, labor utilization, downtime, scrap, throughput, and capacity use to uncover performance trends and improvement opportunities.
• Build and refine financial models that support annual planning, forecasting cycles, and scenario-based decision-making.
• Oversee product costing activities within Microsoft Dynamics 365, including standard cost maintenance, bill of materials alignment, routing accuracy, and annual cost updates.
• Establish uniform costing practices across locations while evaluating profitability by product, customer group, and sales channel.
• Track inventory-related metrics such as valuation, aging, turnover, and working capital, and collaborate with accounting to strengthen controls, reserves, and count processes.
• Act as the key finance advisor to plant, quarry, procurement, and supply chain leadership by providing reporting, dashboards, and actionable performance insights.
• Contribute financial perspective to S&OP discussions and present recommendations to both operational stakeholders and executive leadership.
• Review capital spending proposals through return and payback analysis, while also supporting acquisition assessments, integration efforts, reporting automation, and data quality improvements.
• Provide guidance to entry-level analysts and help advance operational finance capabilities across the team.

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related discipline.
• At least 7 years of experience in cost accounting, manufacturing finance, operational finance, FP&A, or a closely related area.
• Franch language skills are considered a huge plus
• Demonstrated knowledge of standard costing, product costing, manufacturing variance analysis, inventory valuation, and financial modeling.
• Strong understanding of manufacturing economics, including cost drivers tied to scrap, yield, productivity, labor efficiency, and capacity utilization.
• Experience working closely with plant or operations leadership to support performance improvement and business decisions.
• Advanced Excel skills and hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or a similar ERP platform.
• Ability to succeed in a fast-moving environment and willingness to travel up to 20%.
• Additional background in asset-intensive industries, multi-site organizations, continuous improvement environments, or team mentoring is valued.

rows.title: Compliance Specialist
rows.description:
Robert Half Legal is partnering with a technology company operating in the cryptocurrency and financial services space to identify an experienced Compliance Specialist for a short-term (~1 month) contract assignment supporting its legal and compliance team during a parental leave.
The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in financial services regulatory compliance, with hands-on experience supporting multiple compliance functions, including sanctions, marketing and communications review, and regulatory advisory matters.
This position is best suited for a versatile, adaptable compliance professional who is comfortable operating as an individual contributor, can quickly familiarize themselves with existing programs, and independently manage day-to-day compliance responsibilities with minimal ramp-up time.
While direct cryptocurrency experience is preferred, candidates with relevant fintech, banking, payments, broker-dealer, or other regulated financial services experience are encouraged to apply.
Key Responsibilities
Maintain day-to-day regulatory compliance operations for existing financial products and services, including U.S. derivatives and prediction market products operating under applicable regulatory guidance and no-action relief.
Review marketing materials, promotional content, and external communications to identify potential regulatory compliance concerns and ensure alignment with applicable requirements.
Support compliance activities associated with third-party financial product integrations, including coordination with internal stakeholders and external partners.
Administer and maintain the company's existing sanctions compliance program, including monitoring ongoing obligations and addressing compliance-related issues.
Support oversight of U.K. financial promotions compliance requirements, including reviewing applicable communications and maintaining established compliance procedures.
Provide practical regulatory compliance guidance to internal business teams regarding existing products, services, and operational activities.
Monitor geographic restrictions, jurisdiction-specific regulatory requirements, and product availability considerations to support ongoing compliance.
Collaborate with legal, product, and business stakeholders to address emerging compliance questions and maintain continuity of existing compliance programs.

3+ years of experience in regulatory compliance, preferably within fintech, banking, payments, broker-dealer, cryptocurrency, or another regulated financial services environment.
Strong understanding of compliance program operations, regulatory requirements, and day-to-day compliance processes.
Demonstrated experience across multiple compliance disciplines, such as sanctions compliance, marketing and communications review, regulatory advisory, or financial product compliance.
Familiarity with U.S. financial services regulations and compliance considerations associated with regulated financial products.
Exposure to international regulatory requirements, particularly U.K. financial promotions regulations, is a plus.
Experience supporting cryptocurrency, digital assets, derivatives, or prediction market products is highly desirable but not required.
Strong analytical skills, sound judgment, and the ability to identify and escalate regulatory compliance concerns appropriately.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with legal and cross-functional business teams.
Highly adaptable, with the ability to quickly absorb unfamiliar regulatory concepts, systems, and business processes.
Availability to support a short-term assignment with a limited onboarding and training period.

rows.title: Compliance Specialist
rows.description:

This contract opportunity with potential for a permanent role is ideal for a detail-oriented individual who can strengthen regulatory oversight, guide compliance practices, and support both company and carrier-related operations. The role calls for a strong background in insurance regulation, risk-based compliance, and cross-functional operational support within a complex insurance environment.
Responsibilities:
• Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive compliance program that supports insurance operations and aligns with applicable regulatory standards.
• Monitor changing insurance laws, regulations, and filing requirements, translating updates into practical guidance for internal stakeholders.
• Conduct compliance reviews, risk assessments, and due diligence activities to identify gaps and recommend corrective actions.
• Partner with operational and business teams to establish controls, document procedures, and promote consistent adherence to regulatory expectations.

• Support audits, examinations, and regulatory inquiries by preparing documentation, coordinating responses, and tracking follow-up items.

• Significant experience in insurance regulatory compliance, preferably in a senior-level compliance or regulatory management capacity.
• Strong knowledge of insurance carrier operations, regulatory obligations, and compliance risk management practices.
• Background in due diligence, compliance monitoring, and developing controls within insurance-focused organizations.
• Familiarity with admitted, non-admitted, or surplus lines insurance markets is highly valued.
• Ability to interpret regulations, assess operational impact, and communicate compliance expectations clearly across teams.
• Experience supporting audits, regulatory reviews, or formal examinations within a regulated insurance environment.
• Additional exposure to product design compliance, international trade compliance, or insurance licensing is a plus.

rows.title: Compliance Engineer
rows.description:

This role will partner closely with engineering, product management, security, privacy, and business stakeholders to ensure compliance with industry frameworks, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in cloud security, regulatory compliance, audit readiness, and risk management, with experience supporting complex technology organizations and cloud environments.
Responsibilities:
Support security compliance programs and regulatory audits across a portfolio of cloud products and services.
Partner with compliance, security, and engineering teams to establish and maintain common control frameworks and standardized compliance practices.
Collaborate with product teams and business stakeholders to drive adoption of enterprise cloud security and compliance requirements.
Assist in developing and maintaining product compliance roadmaps, ensuring alignment with business objectives, customer commitments, and regulatory obligations.
Support market access and customer assurance initiatives by maintaining compliance with industry-recognized frameworks and certifications.
Serve as a subject matter expert on security compliance frameworks and industry best practices, providing guidance to engineering, security, and product teams.
Conduct security and compliance assessments of cloud-based products, services, and operational processes.
Prepare compliance reports, gap assessments, and remediation recommendations for stakeholders and leadership teams.
Support initiatives involving data privacy, information security, risk management, and cloud governance.
Coordinate audit activities, evidence collection, control testing, risk assessments, and remediation tracking.
Assist with external assessments, certifications, customer audits, and regulatory examinations.

Required Qualifications:
5+ years of experience in information security, governance, risk, compliance (GRC), audit, or related cybersecurity disciplines.
Strong knowledge of cloud security and compliance frameworks, including one or more of the following: ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, SOC 1 / SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST 800-53, HIPAA, ISO 42001
Regional and industry-specific compliance frameworks
Experience supporting compliance audits, certification programs, and regulatory assessments from planning through successful completion.
Proven ability to work across multiple business and technical teams to evaluate requirements, manage compliance initiatives, and drive remediation efforts.
Experience developing compliance reports, control assessments, risk analyses, and executive-level presentations.
Strong understanding of cloud technologies and security principles within SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS environments.
Ability to analyze complex information, assess risks, and make business-focused recommendations in situations involving uncertainty or incomplete data.
Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder communication skills, with experience presenting to technical teams, business leaders, and executive audiences.
Preferred Qualifications:
Professional certifications such as: CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, GIAC certifications, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor
Experience supporting cloud service providers, software companies, enterprise technology organizations, or highly regulated industries.

rows.title: Compliance Manager
rows.description:
We are looking for a Compliance Manager to support a growing healthcare fintech organization in Minneapolis, Minnesota. This Long-term Contract position focuses on strengthening regulatory compliance programs across anti-money laundering, customer due diligence, sanctions oversight, transaction surveillance, and enterprise risk review. The person in this role will help build effective controls, guide internal stakeholders on compliance expectations, and contribute to a strong culture of accountability in a fast-paced startup environment.
Responsibilities:
• Direct compliance activities related to anti-money laundering, customer identification and verification, sanctions review, transaction surveillance, and risk evaluation.
• Examine business processes and controls on a recurring basis to detect compliance gaps and recommend practical corrective actions.
• Create, refine, and maintain policies, procedures, and supporting documentation to align with applicable regulations and internal standards.
• Deliver guidance and training to employees so teams understand regulatory obligations and follow established compliance practices.
• Review transactional activity for unusual patterns, escalate concerns when appropriate, and partner with internal teams on investigations and reporting.
• Track regulatory developments and industry expectations to help keep the compliance program current and effective.
• Plan and support internal audits, control assessments, and monitoring activities to measure the strength of the compliance framework.
• Work with external auditors, examiners, or regulatory parties by preparing materials and responding to compliance-related requests.

• Demonstrated experience in compliance, risk management, or regulatory oversight within financial services, fintech, or a closely related industry.
• Strong working knowledge of anti-money laundering requirements, Bank Secrecy Act principles, know your customer practices, sanctions compliance, and transaction monitoring.
• Ability to conduct risk assessments, compliance reviews, and internal audit activities with a detail-oriented and analytical approach.
• Experience drafting compliance documentation, policies, procedures, and reports for business or leadership audiences.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to present compliance concepts clearly and provide effective staff training.
• Familiarity with compliance systems or software used for monitoring, case management, and reporting activities.
• CAMS certification is preferred.
• Prior experience working in a startup environment is a plus.

rows.title: Compliance Manager
rows.description:
We are looking for a Compliance Manager to join a construction and contractor-focused organization in Rock Hill, South Carolina. This role is ideal for someone who is detail oriented and can lead enterprise training and learning compliance efforts while partnering across HR, leadership, and external vendors to strengthen employee development. The position blends strategic planning with hands-on execution, supporting both virtual and in-person learning programs, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Responsibilities:
• Lead the planning and delivery of companywide learning and compliance programs for employees across multiple functions and locations.
• Coordinate virtual and classroom-based training sessions, ensuring schedules, facilitators, materials, and attendance tracking are managed effectively.
• Oversee annual training events and learning forums by organizing agendas, aligning speakers, and confirming complete session coverage across time zones.
• Monitor training completion and compliance metrics by generating reports from learning systems and sharing insights with key stakeholders.
• Partner with HR leaders and department managers to identify skill gaps and recommend targeted development solutions.
• Build and maintain strong working relationships with internal leaders, technology partners, universities, and outside training providers.
• Support updates to learning content, digital playlists, and training pathways to improve engagement and accessibility for employees.
• Assist with knowledge transfer during the transition from the current role holder and contribute to ongoing improvements in learning operations.
• Travel as needed to support training delivery, stakeholder meetings, and program coordination.

• At least several years of experience managing employee training, learning programs, or compliance-related development initiatives.
• Demonstrated success delivering both instructor-led and online training in a detail-oriented environment.
• Strong working knowledge of learning management systems, training records, and reporting tools.
• Experience analyzing organizational development needs and translating findings into practical learning plans.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with senior leaders, HR teams, and external partners.
• Skilled in coordinating large-scale training events or multi-session programs involving varied audiences.
• Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.

rows.title: Compliance Manager
rows.description:
We are looking for a Compliance Manager to join our client's team in Minnesota (working remotely) on a contract basis with the potential for a permanent role. This position will play a central role in strengthening the company’s financial crime prevention framework by guiding anti-money laundering, customer due diligence, sanctions review, and risk oversight activities. The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of regulatory expectations and help build practical compliance programs that support sound business operations.
Responsibilities:
• Direct and enhance the organization’s anti-money laundering, customer identification, sanctions screening, transaction surveillance, and compliance risk evaluation activities.
• Perform recurring reviews of compliance practices to detect control gaps, emerging issues, and areas requiring corrective action.
• Create, update, and maintain policies, procedures, and internal guidelines that reflect current regulatory standards and industry expectations.
• Deliver training and guidance to employees to improve understanding of compliance obligations and promote consistent adherence across teams.
• Review transactional activity for unusual patterns, escalate concerns appropriately, and partner with stakeholders on investigations and required reporting.
• Track regulatory developments affecting financial crime compliance and recommend program adjustments to maintain alignment with legal requirements.
• Lead internal assessments and audit-related reviews to measure the effectiveness of existing controls and identify improvement opportunities.
• Work closely with external auditors and regulatory agencies by preparing documentation, responding to inquiries, and supporting examinations as needed.

Proven experience in compliance management within financial services or related industries.
Strong knowledge of AML, KYC, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, and risk assessment procedures.
Familiarity with compliance tools and software used for monitoring and reporting activities.
Excellent analytical skills with the ability to assess complex risk scenarios effectively.
Strong communication skills for delivering training sessions and preparing reports for senior management.
Relevant certifications such as CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist) are preferred.
Ability to stay current with regulatory changes and industry best practices.

rows.title: Compliance Manager
rows.description:
Our client, a well-established higher education organization, is seeking an experienced Compliance Manager to provide leadership and guidance across compliance, privacy, and regulatory initiatives. This is an ongoing contract opportunity. We are looking for a seasoned compliance professional who can quickly step into a highly visible role, serve as a trusted resource to stakeholders, and help support ongoing compliance efforts with minimal ramp-up.
The ideal candidate will bring a broad compliance background, strong leadership experience, and prior experience supporting compliance programs within a higher education environment.
Key Responsibilities
Serve as a subject matter resource for compliance, regulatory, and privacy-related questions.
Provide leadership and guidance on compliance initiatives, policies, and best practices.
Partner with internal stakeholders to identify and address compliance risks.
Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of compliance programs.
Assist with audits, investigations, reporting requirements, and regulatory inquiries.
Review and recommend improvements to compliance-related processes and procedures.
Ensure organizational practices align with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies.

Ability to work independently and provide strategic guidance with minimal supervision.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

rows.title: Compliance and Operations Specialist
rows.description:
Robert Half is recruiting for a Compliance Operations Specialist to join a specialized professional services organization providing regulatory compliance support to financial services clients.
This is a fully remote opportunity for an experienced administrative or operations professional who excels at managing detailed processes, maintaining accurate documentation, and independently coordinating multiple responsibilities.
This is a hands-on, execution-focused position requiring exceptional organization, attention to detail, and follow-through. The ideal candidate enjoys structured, process-driven work and takes ownership of responsibilities without requiring constant direction.
Prior regulatory compliance experience is not required. We are particularly interested in candidates with backgrounds in professional services, accounting or audit support, legal administration, compliance coordination, or other documentation-intensive environments.
Key Responsibilities
Manage recurring administrative and compliance-related processes across multiple client accounts.
Maintain compliance calendars, task trackers, checklists, and documentation to ensure deadlines and deliverables are met.

Monitor outstanding items, identify discrepancies, and follow through on missing or incomplete information.
Assist with regulatory filings by gathering information, maintaining records, and coordinating required documentation.
Prepare and customize client-facing materials, presentations, and training documents using established templates.
Document client meetings, maintain action items, and coordinate follow-up activities.

5+ years of experience in administrative operations, professional services support, compliance administration, or a similarly detail-intensive role.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.

Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and accuracy.
Ability to work independently, prioritize competing responsibilities, and follow established procedures with minimal supervision.
