Experience maintaining compliance documentation, coordinating audits, or supporting regulatory processes.
Experience developing checklists, documenting procedures, or improving administrative workflows.
Familiarity with compliance management software or similar document-tracking systems

rows.title: Trade Compliance Attorney
rows.description:
We are looking for a Trade Compliance Attorney to support our client on a contract basis. This role will advise business stakeholders on complex customs and international trade matters while helping build a more proactive and efficient compliance approach. The ideal candidate can turn evolving regulatory requirements into practical business guidance and identify opportunities to reduce risk, improve processes, and support informed operational decisions.
Responsibilities:
• Advise cross-functional teams on daily and long-range customs and trade compliance issues affecting retail operations.
• Interpret import and export requirements, including product classification, customs valuation, and country-of-origin considerations.
• Counsel business leaders on duty mitigation strategies, duty suspension programs, and the use of applicable free trade agreement benefits.
• Assess potential exposure related to anti-dumping and countervailing duties, including scope reviews for products that have been flagged.
• Track U.S. and foreign trade regulations and explain new or changing rules in clear, practical terms for internal stakeholders.
• Develop and refine customs compliance procedures that strengthen controls and support a more strategic operating model.
• Provide timely legal guidance in response to internal questions, clearly outlining risks, options, and recommended actions.
• Identify opportunities to streamline trade compliance practices and improve cost efficiency through product, sourcing, or process-related recommendations.

• Juris Doctor degree and active license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
• Demonstrated experience advising on customs law, import/export compliance, and international trade regulations.
• Strong knowledge of tariff classification, customs valuation, rules of origin, and free trade agreement analysis.
• Experience evaluating anti-dumping and countervailing duty matters, including product scope assessments.
• Ability to translate complex legal and regulatory issues into concise, business-focused guidance.
• Proven skill in partnering with business teams to improve compliance processes and support strategic decision-making.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to respond quickly to time-sensitive requests.

rows.title: International Trade Compliance Specialist
rows.description:
We are looking for a International Trade Compliance Specialist to support trade compliance and purchasing activities for a Contract position based in Minneapolis, Minnesota. This role focuses on coordinating shipment clearance, confirming tariff classifications, and gathering required documentation to help materials move efficiently through customs. An ideal candidate will be a detail-oriented, self-starting trade compliance professional who can independently manage day-to-day import and export activities, quickly resolve customs and carrier issues, validate trade data and documentation, and keep goods moving efficiently through the global supply chain.
Responsibilities:
• Manage customs clearance activities for incoming shipments by coordinating required information and helping ensure timely release of goods.
• Review and confirm tariff classifications and related trade data to support accurate import documentation and regulatory adherence.
• Follow up with internal teams, suppliers, and external partners to collect shipment details and resolve missing or incomplete information.
• Support procurement operations by creating, updating, and tracking purchase orders in alignment with established buying procedures.
• Assist with contract-related purchasing activities, including reviewing terms and helping maintain compliance with procurement policies.
• Monitor shipment and purchasing records in Excel and other tracking tools to maintain accurate documentation and reporting.
• Work across procurement and compliance functions to address exceptions, reduce delays, and support smooth transactions.

• 2+ years of experience in international trade compliance, customs compliance, import/export operations, or global logistics.
• Hands-on experience working with customs brokers, freight forwarders, carriers, and government trade requirements.
• Strong understanding of import/export documentation, HTS classifications, tariff codes, country of origin, and customs clearance processes.
• Highly detail-oriented with strong organizational and follow-up skills.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for tracking, analysis, and reporting.
• Self-starter who can independently manage priorities and drive issue resolution.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively across operations, supply chain, engineering, and external partners.

rows.title: Corporate Governance Paralegal
rows.description:
We are looking for a Corporate Governance Paralegal to support a financial services organization in Pennsylvania. This Long-term Contract position is ideal for a highly organized individual with strong experience in corporate governance, board support, and securities-related filings. The role will focus on preparing governance documentation, coordinating recurring reporting activities, and helping maintain accurate records for board and regulatory matters. Strong writing ability, sound judgment, and the capacity to manage sensitive information with precision will be essential for success.
Responsibilities:
• Prepare and organize board and committee materials, including agendas, resolutions, meeting records, and supporting documentation for leadership review.
• Coordinate the development and distribution of board books while ensuring materials are complete, accurate, and delivered on schedule.
• Draft, revise, and maintain corporate records such as meeting minutes, governance documents, and related approval materials.
• Support securities compliance activities by assisting with Forms 3 and 4, quarterly reporting tasks, and other SEC-related documentation.
• Administer director and officer questionnaires, including distribution, follow-up, collection, and review of submitted responses for completeness.
• Assist with related-party information gathering and tracking to support governance reviews and disclosure processes.
• Work closely with internal stakeholders to compile data required for filings, board reporting, and other corporate governance obligations.
• Maintain organized documentation within case management or recordkeeping systems to support audit readiness and efficient retrieval of key materials.

• Demonstrated experience as a corporate paralegal, with a strong background in governance support and board-related documentation.
• Hands-on knowledge of SEC filing processes, including experience supporting Forms 3 and 4 and periodic reporting activities.
• Familiarity with insider trading compliance concepts and corporate disclosure practices.
• Excellent written communication skills with the ability to prepare accurate, well-structured documentation.
• High level of attention to detail and the ability to manage confidential information with discretion.
• Experience supporting boards of directors, advisory boards, or senior leadership governance activities.
• Proficiency with document management or case management software used for legal or corporate records administration.

rows.title: Workday Change Manager
rows.description:
We are looking for a Workday Change Manager to guide organizational readiness and user adoption for a major enterprise transformation in St Marys City, Maryland. This Long-term Contract position will help faculty, staff, leaders, and other stakeholder groups navigate changes to processes, responsibilities, and day-to-day operations tied to the Workday program. The person in this role will collaborate across project, functional, technical, training, and communications teams to build a practical change approach that supports engagement, preparedness, and sustained adoption.
Responsibilities:
• Create and manage a comprehensive change management roadmap that aligns with the overall Workday project timeline and major milestones.
• Evaluate how different stakeholder groups will be affected by the implementation, updating impact and readiness assessments as business processes and system designs evolve.
• Build engagement plans that encourage participation from key audiences and maintain involvement throughout the project lifecycle.
• Partner with project leadership and communications teams to shape targeted messaging, determine delivery timing, and select effective communication channels for each audience.
• Translate process and system updates into straightforward guidance that explains what is changing, who is impacted, and what new actions will be expected.
• Anticipate resistance points or adoption challenges and put mitigation strategies in place to improve understanding and acceptance.
• Organize and support a network of change champions, super users, or departmental representatives to reinforce adoption across the organization.
• Coordinate with the Training Lead to ensure role-based learning plans and materials reflect identified process and responsibility changes.
• Measure organizational readiness before go-live and monitor post-launch feedback to recommend reinforcement through communication, training, or leadership support.
• Track change-related risks, dependencies, and key decisions, and provide regular updates and recommendations to project leadership and governance teams.

• 5+ years of hands-on experience leading change management efforts, including support for ERP, financial systems, or Workday-related programs.
• Proven background managing change across multiple business functions such as Finance, Human Resources, Payroll, or student-focused administration.
• Strong ability to simplify complex system or process updates into practical, user-friendly messaging for nontechnical audiences.
• Experience performing stakeholder analysis, change impact assessments, and organizational readiness evaluations.
• Demonstrated success working with executives, project leaders, functional teams, technical teams, communications partners, and external implementation providers.
• Excellent facilitation, communication, and relationship-building skills in cross-functional environments.
• Familiarity with change management tools, business requirements documentation, and enterprise platforms such as Oracle NetSuite, Epicor, or related technologies.

Job Description
Insight Global is looking to hire a Change Management Analyst sitting remotely. This person will support a federal customer within their financial organization, specifically across acquisitions and budget functions. The team currently relies heavily on financial analysts and SMEs for user questions, information requests, approvals, and support, creating a need for a more clearly defined and consistent process.

The Change Management Analyst will evaluate existing processes and documentation and help build a more structured approach for how users access information, request support, obtain approvals, and escalate questions. This person will help clarify where different requests should go, improve existing process documentation, and develop communications and training materials that make it easier for users to navigate the newly implemented financial tool. The goal is to create a more consistent user experience while reducing unnecessary coordination and reliance on financial analysts and SMEs.

Key responsibilities will include:
•	Reviewing existing process documentation and identifying opportunities to build upon and clarify current processes
•	Defining clearer processes for how users request information, support, and approvals
•	Establishing a more consistent approach for how users reach out for support and where different requests should be routed
•	Developing and updating process documentation, communications, and training materials
•	Coordinating with financial analysts, SMEs, federal IT PMs, and tool users to understand needs and improve the overall support process
•	Helping ensure questions, support requests, enhancement requests, tickets, and approvals are directed to the appropriate owners

Compensation: 
$62.00/hr to $68.00/hr. 

Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education. 

Employees in this role will enjoy a comprehensive benefits package starting on day one of employment, including options for medical, dental, and vision insurance. Eligibility to enroll in the 401(k) retirement plan begins after 90 days of employment. Additionally, employees in this role will have access to paid sick leave and other paid time off benefits as required under the applicable law of the worksite location.

Job Description
Insight Global is looking for an Analytics Manager / Business Insights Manager to lead and develop a small team of analysts while remaining highly hands-on in the actual analytical work. This is a true player-coach role. The manager will personally write SQL, investigate complex or ambiguous business questions, review analysts' work, prioritize incoming requests, and communicate findings directly to senior leadership.

A typical assignment could start with leadership identifying an unusual subscriber, revenue, billing, or engagement trend. This person will determine how to investigate it, query the underlying data, partner with the appropriate stakeholders, identify what is driving the trend, and present a concise explanation and recommendation back to leadership.

A major priority will also be helping the organization establish a more consistent source of truth for business metrics. The manager will partner across the organization to define metrics and business logic, then work with Data Engineering to ensure those definitions are represented appropriately within the data environment.

The broader organization is currently modernizing its data environment, including a migration to Snowflake and a move from Mode to Omni for BI/reporting. This person will help rebuild dashboards and reporting while improving how Analytics prioritizes and delivers work. This is a fully remote role and a contract to hire position. 

Day to Day 
	- Standardize metrics
		○ Work across business functions to define the company's core metrics.
		○ Establish consistent definitions, filters, calculations, and business logic.
		○ Partner with data engineering to eventually embed that logic into the company's semantic/data layer.
	-  Executive & stakeholder partnership
		○ Work directly with senior leaders.
		○ Own significant analytics work coming out of the weekly executive review.
		○ Translate business questions into actionable analytics work.
		○ Help determine which analytics problems should actually be prioritized.
	-  People leadership
		○ Coach and mentor analysts, particularly more junior team members.
		○ Review and guide their work.
		○ Help improve the overall quality of analytics delivered by the team.
	- Remain hands-on
		○ This person will be expected to write SQL daily, potentially multiple times per day.
		○ Perform their own analysis rather than simply delegating work.
        - Presentation/storytelling skills are critical because the previous search struggled to find candidates who could combine analytics skills with strong executive presentation capabilities.

This role is essential in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions, ensuring that data-driven initiatives are accurately scoped, documented, and delivered.  

Key Responsibilities: Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with stakeholders to elicit and document detailed business and technical requirements. Translate business needs into clear, actionable specifications for data engineering teams.  

Workflow & Process Diagramming: Create and maintain process flow diagrams, data flow diagrams, and system interaction models. Visualize current and future state workflows to support solution design and gap analysis.  

Business Rules Documentation: Identify and document business rules governing data processing, transformation, and validation. Ensure rules are clearly communicated and traceable throughout the project lifecycle.  

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a liaison between business and technical stakeholders, developers, and QA testers. Provide clarification and support throughout the design, development, and testing phases. Builds strong, collaborative relationships with team members and stakeholders.  

Quality Assurance and User Acceptance Testing Support: Assist in reviewing test cases and validating implementation against requirements. Participate in defect triage and resolution discussions.  

Project Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation including user stories, acceptance criteria, and traceability matrices. Ensure documentation is version-controlled and accessible to relevant teams.

The pay rate ranges based on years of experience and data engineering expertise between $50-60/hour.

rows.description:

-Proven ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

-Pay rate between $40-60/hr

Job Description
Job Description
An Insight Global client is seeking a Reconstruction and Operations Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations and financial performance of a growing reconstruction and repair division in the greater Charlotte, North Carolina area.
This individual will take ownership of residential reconstruction projects from an approved scope through final completion. The role combines construction management, operational leadership, subcontractor coordination, budgeting, customer service, and process implementation.
The ideal candidate will have a strong residential construction background, and the business judgment needed to professionalize a growing division. This person will be responsible for establishing repeatable processes, creating accountability across projects, protecting profitability, improving the customer experience, and providing leadership with confidence that reconstruction operations are being managed effectively.
This is a hands-on management position. While the primary responsibility is leading the division, the Reconstruction and Operations Manager must be willing to step directly into project management, customer escalation, scheduling, estimating, or field coordination when necessary.
Day to Day
Own the reconstruction and repair division from start to finish: active projects, field operations, scheduling, customer communication and financial results. Step in to manage projects directly when needed.
Lead project managers, field staff and subcontractors, and build repeatable processes and accountability checks that let the division grow without losing quality or profit.
Oversee multiple residential and commercial projects, manage the critical path, and sequence trades (framing, roofing, drywall, finishes, MEP) so jobs keep moving.
Visit job sites regularly to check workmanship, safety, schedule and scope, and make sure defects, code issues and risks get fixed quickly.
Own budgets, change orders and margins: review scopes, insurance estimates and Xactimate line items, track costs in real time, and approve subcontractor draws only after checking progress against milestones.
Build and manage a broad network of subcontractors: get competitive bids, check licensing and insurance, and hold trade partners to agreed quality, schedules and pricing.
Act as the main escalation point for homeowners and commercial customers, explain scope, insurance limits, delays and change orders clearly, and handle complaints professionally.
Coordinate permits and inspections, keep projects compliant with the North Carolina State Building Code, keep accurate records, and manage closeout through final inspection, customer signoff and payment reconciliation.

Job Description
We are seeking a hands-on IT Project Manager to lead technology implementations supporting new and existing warehouse and distribution operations. This individual will serve as the lead IT representative for assigned projects and own delivery from initial kickoff and planning through implementation, stabilization, and closeout.

Projects will primarily involve Warehouse Management System (WMS) implementations, including greenfield/startup environments and conversions of existing warehouse operations to new WMS solutions. The Project Manager will coordinate across WMS, infrastructure, networking, integrations, operations, and other technical workstreams.

This position requires someone who can independently build and manage detailed project plans, drive cross-functional teams against those plans, and confidently manage both internal and client stakeholders. This is a hands-on delivery role rather than a high-level PMO or Program Management position.

Day to Day:
Lead warehouse technology projects from kickoff/initiation through implementation, go-live, stabilization, and closeout.
Serve as the lead IT representative responsible for driving overall project delivery.
Build, baseline, maintain, and actively manage detailed project schedules.
Define and manage tasks, owners, start/finish dates, milestones, predecessors, dependencies, and interdependencies.
Drive project execution against established schedules and adjust plans as requirements, resources, timelines, and dependencies change.
Coordinate technical workstreams across WMS, infrastructure, networking, integrations, and other warehouse technologies.
Partner with technical SMEs, operations teams, and other Project Managers throughout implementation.
Manage projects through the complete IT solution delivery lifecycle, including requirements, design, build, testing/validation, deployment, stabilization/support, and closeout.
Manage scope, timeline, resource, and delivery tradeoffs with internal and client stakeholders.
Lead projects involving either new warehouse/startup implementations or conversions of existing operations to new WMS platforms.
Facilitate challenging stakeholder discussions using project schedules, facts, dependencies, and delivery constraints to drive decisions.

Pay rate: 55-70/hr. depending on experience and determined by the hiring manager during interview process 

100% remote US based, but MUST be open to up to 25% travel, including travel outside of the US

rows.title: Environmental Compliance Specialist
rows.description:
Required Skills & Experience

-Strong analytical skills and ability to work with technical or environmental data.
-Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word.
-Strong written communication skills, particularly for technical reports and documentation.

Job Description
We are seeking an Entry-Level Environmental Compliance Specialist to support environmental and air quality compliance projects within the solid waste industry. This individual will work with landfill gas, emissions, and environmental monitoring data to help facilities maintain compliance with applicable air regulations and permit requirements.

The role will involve data analysis, compliance reporting, emissions calculations, air permitting support, and coordination with field and technical teams. Key areas of focus include landfill gas (LFG), Surface Emissions Monitoring (SEM), Landfill Gas-to-Energy (LFGTE) systems, NSPS/NESHAP requirements, and air quality permitting.

This is a primarily remote position with limited travel/site visits as needed. Candidates must be located in PST, MST, or CST.

Key Responsibilities
-Review and analyze landfill gas, wellfield, SEM, and air emissions data.
-Compare monitoring and operational data against permit requirements and applicable NSPS/NESHAP regulations.
-Prepare environmental compliance reports, monitoring summaries, deviation analyses, and regulatory documentation.
-Assist with air permit applications, renewals, and amendments, including emissions calculations.
-Manage and organize large environmental datasets, compliance deadlines, and facility-specific reporting requirements.

● 5-7+ years of professional experience in dietary supplement or CPG regulatory environments, including FDA regulations (21 CFR), cGMP, product labeling and claim substantiation.

Job Description
The Compliance Manager leads the regulatory and compliance team for our client's portfolios, 
covering regulatory compliance, international market readiness, product certifications, and marketing and labeling 
compliance. Reporting to the Director of Quality and Compliance, the role is the bridge between the regulatory team and 
the Director: routine decisions, document requests and day-to-day escalations stop here, so the Director can lead the full 
quality system rather than work inside it. 

The Compliance Manager leads a team of regulatory specialists, sets the standard for their work, reviews and approves at overview level, and builds a clear development path to management. The role is expected to help hire and onboard 
the specialist team quickly, so the function is seated and trained, and ready to keep the business always ready: documentation built before it is requested, certifications current, and new retailers and international markets answered 
with a confident yes.

rows.title: Senior Agile IT Project Manager - Medicare Technology
rows.description:

Job Description
Insight Global is seeking a Senior Agile Project Manager to support Technology, Business, and Operations teams to support delivery across Medicare Senior Supplemental and Ancillary products, including Medicare Supplement, Recovery Care and Home Care, Hospital Indemnity, Final Expense, Critical Illness, and Dental, Vision, and Hearing.

•	Program/Project Management: Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives across multiple teams and domains, driving clarity around scope, timelines, ownership, milestones, dependencies, risks, and decisions.

Previous leadership of at least one company wide ERP implementation or similar large scale, multi-year cross functional systems integration and project implementation (in a health care setting).

Ability to understand and work with complex and challenging business processes and technical environments.

Ability to work in a highly collaborative manner in order to achieve results that are significant in scope.

Nice to Have Skills & Experience

Job Description
The Administrative Systems Project Manager applies advanced technical project management frameworks and methods in conjunction with Campus and UCSF Health objectives to plan and execute enterprise administrative application domains (primarily Finance and Supply Chain) projects. The Administrative Systems Project Manager is an experienced technical/functional professional who can resolve highly complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. The Project Manager determines methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria to obtain results and manages projects of broad and diverse scope, size, impact, budget, and/or project team size with considerable effect on the organization.


The Administrative Systems Project Manager will manage portions of the project lifecycle of a significant re-implementation of our ERP ecosystem, from project implementation through post-implementation support. The scope of this project includes the design, configuration, testing, training, and implementation/transition to the new ERP platform itself as well as the associated development of required custom functionality, reporting, interfaces, and other applications and middleware to replace previous customizations and other end-of-life business systems that comprise the enterprise systems environment. The person in this role will be accountable for ensuring the project meets agreed-upon scope, cost, schedule, and quality measures.

Deliverables:
Under direction from the VP of Enterprise Applications (or delegate), provides leadership on the full workstream for the ERP project related to the design, development, and implementation. Documents and escalates project risks and issues for mitigation.

Within diverse cross-functional teams focused on the ERP projects, uses an inclusive, team-based approach to develop and coordinate detailed project plans, establish milestones and timelines, enforce project deadlines and schedules, and monitor budget and resource requirements, with the goal of completing the projects to the highest quality, on schedule and within budget.

Applies current IT Project Management Office standards and procedures to the ERP projects, liaises, communicates and builds partnerships within UCSF IT and the broader UCSF community to plan and execute ERP projects, with overall project management responsibility for these efforts from initiation to completion.

Gathers, analyzes and synthesizes complex data and information in reports, presentations and other formats to communicate project details, status, results and lessons learned to IT leadership as well as to departmental stakeholders.

rows.title: Remote Community Impact Program Manager
rows.description:
Required Skills & Experience
5+ years of experience in Community Impact, Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), Corporate Philanthropy, Employee Engagement, Nonprofit Partnerships, or a related field.
Proven success leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from assessment through implementation.
Experience managing corporate foundations, grants administration, community investment programs, or philanthropy operations.
Experience with grant management platforms such as Benevity, YourCause, CyberGrants, or similar systems.
Experience working with nonprofit organizations and community partners.
Demonstrated ability to manage programs involving multiple stakeholders, regions, or business functions.
Experience analyzing engagement and impact data to drive operational improvements.
Ability to work independently and effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Job Description
Sysco is seeking an experienced Community Impact Program Manager to support the execution and continuous improvement of strategic initiatives across its Community Impact portfolio. This role will provide hands-on leadership in managing community engagement programs, philanthropy reporting, foundation operations, grant administration, and product donation initiatives.
The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can quickly assess existing processes, drive operational improvements, manage complex cross-functional projects, and translate strategy into scalable systems and actionable outcomes. This position reports directly to the Director of Community Impact and partners closely with internal stakeholders, nonprofit organizations, regional teams, and community partners to ensure programs are effectively managed, measured, and aligned with business priorities.
This opportunity is ideal for a professional passionate about corporate social responsibility, community engagement, philanthropy, data-driven decision-making, and building meaningful social impact programs.
Key Responsibilities
Global Good Data Management & Reporting
Manage the collection, validation, reconciliation, and reporting of Global Good program data across philanthropy, product donations, and volunteer engagement initiatives.
Ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across multiple reporting sources.
Develop and implement process improvements that enhance reporting efficiency, visibility, and data quality.
Create reporting tools, dashboards, and metrics that support organizational decision-making and impact measurement.
Foundation Operations & Governance
Support the administration and governance of the Sysco Foundation and Sysco Disaster Relief Foundation.
Manage grant-related documentation, approvals, payments, budgets, compliance tracking, reporting, and record retention.
Coordinate Foundation activities and maintain operational processes.
Prepare presentations, reports, and materials for Foundation leadership and Board meetings.
Identify operational, governance, and compliance gaps and recommend sustainable solutions.
Benevity Grants Implementation
Lead the implementation, configuration, and optimization of the Benevity Grants platform.
Design and develop grant applications, workflows, approval processes, communications, reporting structures, and system documentation.
Partner with stakeholders to ensure successful adoption and ongoing program effectiveness.
Establish scalable processes for grants administration and impact reporting.
Product Donation Strategy & Program Assessment
Conduct a comprehensive assessment of Sysco's current product donation practices, site processes, tracking methodologies, and nonprofit partnerships.
Benchmark industry best practices in product donation, food recovery, and hunger-relief programs.
Identify operational, measurement, reporting, and educational gaps.
Develop recommendations for a standardized enterprise-wide product donation strategy.
Enhance site playbooks, training materials, measurement frameworks, and implementation roadmaps to support program consistency and effectiveness.
Stakeholder Engagement
Collaborate with internal departments, nonprofit partners, regional teams, and community stakeholders.
Facilitate alignment between community impact initiatives and broader business objectives.
Support the successful execution of strategic community engagement programs and initiatives.

Job Description
The Procurement Operations Specialist supports day-to-day procurement activities with a primary focus on services sourcing, vendor coordination, contracting, and purchase-to-pay processes. This role works closely with internal stakeholders, subject-matter experts, legal teams, and vendors to coordinate sourcing activities, support RFP/RFQ processes, organize commercial evaluations, and help ensure procurement transactions move efficiently through established approval processes.

The role will also support vendor onboarding, Statements of Work (SOWs), contract coordination, purchase requisitions and purchase orders, service receipt verification, supplier performance tracking, and procurement reporting. This position is well suited for an early-to-mid-career professional looking to build deeper expertise in procurement operations while taking increasing ownership of sourcing and contract-coordination activities within a fast-paced environment.

-          Hands-on experience facilitating sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Ability to run all five scrum ceremonies.

Job Description
Insight Global is seeking a Senior Project Manager to join one of our Technology Services clients and sit fully remote. This individual will support the Value Creation Office (VCO) and lead high-visibility technology initiatives across several deliverables and delivery methodologies. The ideal candidate is a proven execution leader who can drive day-to-day performance while maintaining program-level visibility into objectives, risks, dependencies, and business outcomes. This individual will own end-to-end project delivery, including scope, schedule, budget, resources, risk, quality, and stakeholder communications. They will facilitate Agile ceremonies, manage sprint execution, maintain project plans, and RAID logs, and ensure delivery teams remain focused on business priorities. The Senior Project Manager / Scrum Master will partner closely with Product Managers to translate priorities into actionable sprint plans while driving accountability and removing delivery impediments. This person will collaborate across Product, Engineering, Finance, PMO, Change Management, Revenue Operations, IT, and executive leadership teams to ensure alignment across multiple workstreams. They will serve as the primary point of coordination for third-party vendors and development partners, monitoring KPIs, managing delivery milestones, escalating risks, and ensuring commitments are achieved. As the organization continues to mature its delivery capabilities, this individual will help establish governance, operating rhythms, and scalable project delivery practices. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who can confidently engage VP-level stakeholders and above, think critically through complex challenges, and successfully lead projects from initiation through implementation while leveraging the appropriate delivery methodology for each initiative.

rows.title: Project Manager, Corporate Real Estate
rows.description:

stages)

rows.title: Senior Business Analyst - Order Management + Digital Customer Experience
rows.description:
Required Skills & Experience

o	User story and ticket creation

o	UAT planning and execution
o	Test-script development

•	Ability to identify incomplete, inconsistent, or unclear requirements before they move into development.
•	Experience collaborating directly with software developers, Product Owners, QA/testing teams, and other technical resources.
•	Strong understanding of how business and functional requirements can affect backend systems and technical functionality.
•	Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Job Description
We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to support a global digital technology team focused on enhancing order management and customer-facing digital capabilities. This individual will serve as a key connection point between business stakeholders, Product Owners, customers, and technical development teams. The ideal candidate brings strong traditional Business Analyst skills while also being highly comfortable in a customer-facing environment, translating complex business needs into clear, actionable requirements for development teams. The role will have a particular focus on order management workflows, including areas such as order history, returns, rebates, and related digital customer experiences. Traditional e-commerce experience is beneficial but is not required. Candidates with experience supporting enterprise digital platforms, business applications, order management solutions, or other complex, requirements-heavy technology environments are encouraged to apply.
Key Responsibilities:
•	Partner with business stakeholders, Product Owners, customers, developers, and technical teams to understand business needs and translate them into detailed functional requirements.
•	Lead requirements-gathering sessions and proactively identify gaps, dependencies, inconsistencies, and downstream impacts.
•	Create and maintain user stories, tickets, functional requirements, and detailed acceptance criteria.
•	Translate complex business processes into requirements that development teams can effectively design and build against.
•	Support digital capabilities associated with order management, potentially including: 
o	Order history and order visibility
o	Returns
o	Rebates
o	Customer support workflows
o	Case management
o	Related order-management functionality
•	Lead or support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including: 
o	UAT planning
o	Test scenario and test-script development
o	Test-data preparation
o	Execution and coordination
o	Defect identification and validation
o	Business sign-off
•	Work closely with developers to understand how functional requirements may impact backend systems, integrations, data, and technical workflows.
•	Communicate requirements, recommendations, risks, and process changes clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
•	Facilitate conversations with customers and business stakeholders and constructively challenge requirements when additional clarification or analysis is needed.
•	Participate in cross-functional collaboration with globally distributed teams, including development resources based in India.
•	Evaluate opportunities to use AI tools within Business Analyst workflows to improve requirements analysis, documentation, research, testing preparation, and overall productivity.
•	Maintain strong attention to detail throughout the requirements, development, testing, and delivery lifecycle.

		 • Requirements documentation
		 • User-story development
		 • UAT/test scenario creation
		 • Research and analysis
		 • Documentation and summarization
		 • Workflow/process improvement
Job Description
Day to Day:
We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst / Product Owner to support complex, cross-functional initiatives within a large healthcare organization that is transitioning toward a product-based operating model. This person will initially sit in a Senior Business Analyst capacity but should bring a strong Product Owner mindset. The ideal candidate will go beyond traditional requirements gathering and be comfortable owning work across the delivery lifecycle, partnering across multiple applications and teams, prioritizing requirements, developing user stories, and translating between business and technical stakeholders. This is a replacement for an individual who retired and is not tied to one specific application or functional area. The consultant will operate at a broader project level and may coordinate across multiple BAs, Product Owners, business stakeholders, and technology teams.
 
Ideal Candidate:

The strongest candidate will be someone who has operated in a hybrid Senior BA/Product Owner capacity and is comfortable moving beyond traditional requirements gathering.
They should understand the broader business problem, work effectively across interconnected teams and applications, and translate business needs into actionable work. Because the organization is evolving toward a product operating model, someone who already thinks and operates like a Product Owner while remaining hands-on as a BA will stand out.
Healthcare and Medicare knowledge are valuable, but the team is open to a strong BA/PO from another complex environment if they demonstrate exceptional learning agility.

Experience:

	• Targeting approximately 5+ years of relevant experience, but there is flexibility.
	• Do not automatically disqualify candidates with more than 8 years of experience.
	• Quality and complexity of experience, senior-level judgment, communication, and learning agility are more important than an arbitrary number of years.

rows.title: Program Manager - Process Design & Improvement: Claims

rows.title: Sr. Business Systems Analyst
rows.description:
Required Skills & Experience
• 5+ years of end-user support and training experience.
	• 5+ years of experience working with relevant business systems/applications.
	• 5+ years of functional experience within a relevant business area.
	• 5+ years of systems design, testing, and implementation experience.
	• 2+ years of project management experience.
	• 2+ years of script development and application testing experience.
	• Experience gathering and managing business requirements.
	• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
	• Ability to translate technical concepts into clear, understandable information for business stakeholders.
	• Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
	• Strong verbal and written communication skills.
	• Strong presentation and end-user training capabilities.
	• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
	• Understanding of business workflows, processes, and system dependencies.
	• Experience partnering across business and technology teams.
Nice to Have Skills & Experience
• Advanced knowledge of business-specific enterprise applications or systems.
	• Experience supporting complex system enhancements and implementations.
	• Experience developing test plans, test cases, and supporting UAT.
	• Experience developing reports, queries, and system analysis.
	• Experience working directly with IT development teams and third-party vendors.
	• Experience developing process documentation, training materials, and system procedures.
Ability to operate effectively with changing priorities and ambiguity
Job Description
The Senior Business Systems Analyst will serve as a liaison between business stakeholders and technology teams to analyze business needs, identify system and process improvements, document requirements, support system enhancements, coordinate testing, and troubleshoot application or system issues.
This individual will combine strong business analysis skills with technical and functional systems knowledge to translate business needs into actionable requirements and solutions. The role will work cross-functionally with business stakeholders, IT teams, analysts, customers, vendors, and other partners supporting moderately complex systems and initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
	• Gather, analyze, validate, and document business and functional requirements.
	• Partner with business stakeholders to understand workflows, business objectives, pain points, and system needs.
	• Analyze existing processes, systems, databases, and tools and recommend improvements, simplification, or enhancements.
	• Translate business requirements into clear system and process requirements.
	• Serve as a subject matter expert for assigned business applications and processes.
	• Troubleshoot system issues and coordinate resolution with IT teams and external service providers.
	• Track system issues through resolution and communicate status and outcomes to impacted stakeholders.
	• Support the design and implementation of system enhancements and process improvements.
	• Develop or contribute to test plans, test scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
	• Execute or coordinate testing for system fixes, enhancements, releases, changes, and implementations.
	• Validate functionality and business acceptance of system changes.
	• Monitor system performance, usage, and trends to identify potential problems or improvement opportunities.
	• Maintain system configurations, procedures, change documentation, and other supporting system documentation.
	• Develop and maintain standardized reports, ad hoc reports, and data queries as required.
	• Coordinate system enhancements and project activities with IT, business stakeholders, analysts, customers, and vendors.
	• Develop training materials and provide end-user training and support for new or existing functionality.
	• Track project and enhancement progress and communicate updates to impacted stakeholders.
May provide guidance or mentorship to less-experienced analysts.

rows.title: Program Manager - Federal Contracts
rows.description:
Fully Remote Opportunity. Must have a Secret Clearance.
Description
Overview:
Our client is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Program Manager to lead the operations, compliance, and growth of the company's SEWP VI contract portfolio. The SEWP VI Program Manager serves as the primary interface with the SEWP Program Management Office (PMO) and is responsible for the successful administration and strategic utilization of the company's SEWP VI contracts.
The Program Manager will establish and mature the SEWP operating model, develop scalable business processes, coordinate cross-functional execution, and ensure compliance with contract requirements.
Working closely with leadership, capture, sales, contracts, finance, operations, and partner teams, the Program Manager will help maximize contract utilization, strengthen OEM relationships, improve organizational readiness, and drive long-term growth through the SEWP vehicle. Success in this role is measured by the ability to deliver operational excellence, support revenue growth, enhance customer satisfaction, and build a scalable SEWP business capability.
Primary Responsibilities
Contract Leadership & Administration
Serve as the designated Program Manager and primary point of contact with the SEWP Program Management Office (PMO).
Manage day-to-day operations of the SEWP VI contracts and ensure compliance with program policies, procedures, reporting requirements, and contractual obligations.
Lead contract onboarding, contract modifications, deliverables, audits, inspections, and ongoing contract administration activities.
Monitor and manage SEWP Program Performance metrics, corrective actions, and customer satisfaction activities to maintain the company in good standing and maximize contract utilization.
Governance, Process & Operations
Establish and continuously improve the governance framework, operating procedures, workflows, and controls required to effectively manage the SEWP program.
Coordinate cross-functional execution across Contracts, Finance, Procurement, Engineering, Operations, Security, Marketing, Capture, and Federal Sales teams.
Maintain readiness for audits, reporting requirements, contract reviews, and performance assessments.
Contract Catalog, OEM & Partner Management
Lead Technology Refresh (TR) activities, catalog maintenance, pricing updates, and contract offering management.
Manage relationships with OEMs, distributors, strategic partners, and subcontractors supporting SEWP opportunities.
Coordinate product authorizations, registrations, sourcing, pricing support, and fulfillment processes.
Ensure contract offerings remain current, competitive, and aligned with customer demand.
Business Growth & Customer Success
Partner with Capture Management and Account Executives to maximize utilization and growth of the SEWP vehicle.
Support opportunity qualification, RFQ responses, pricing activities, and contract execution efforts.
Drive customer satisfaction, contract adoption, and revenue growth across SEWP Categories A and C
Compliance, Reporting & Training
Manage contract reporting, required deliverables, certifications, and compliance requirements, including C-SCRM, AbilityOne, and related contract obligations.
Oversee maintenance of SEWP-specific web resources, ordering guides, and customer-facing contract information.
Develop and deliver internal training, playbooks, and knowledge resources supporting successful SEWP execution.
Leadership
Provide leadership and direction for the SEWP Program Office, including the Deputy Program Manager and other assigned support personnel.
Lead internal governance activities and drive accountability across participating business functions.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
710 years of experience supporting federal programs, contract operations, business operations, acquisition environments, or complex cross-functional initiatives.
Demonstrated experience establishing processes, governance structures, and operational frameworks supporting federal IT, technology, or professional services programs.
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to coordinate and influence cross-functional stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Desired Qualifications
Experience with SEWP or other GWACs/IDIQs/MACs/BPAs.
Knowledge of federal acquisition regulations and contract administration.
Capture/proposal/business development experience.
OEM and partner management experience.
Technical understanding of networking, cybersecurity, cloud, managed services, or federal IT.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
Active federal security clearance or ability to obtain one.

rows.title: Operations Specialist
rows.description:
Description
We are seeking a highly organized, analytical, and proactive Operations Associate to help drive the firms day-to-day operating rhythm and create meaningful capacity for the Chief of Staff.
This person will monitor the pulse of the organization. They will own recurring operational workflows, maintain accurate staffing and business data, monitor cross-departmental activity, note key business priorities, and provide the Chief of Staff with clear, concise summaries of what is happening across the organization. The role will also support one-off analyses, requests, and operational priorities as they arise.
This is an analytical operations role, not a traditional executive assistant position, with potential to grow into a critical part of the business. The successful candidate will be comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy, managing competing priorities, responding quickly, and making progress without waiting for constant direction. They will be expected to close lingering loops through dedicated follow-up with appropriate stakeholders, identify issues before they become problems, and keep the Chief of Staff appropriately informed, escalating when necessary.
The workload will vary from day to day. During quieter periods, the Operations Associate will be expected to use time productively for documentation in our software systems, data cleanup in Excel, process improvement internally, training materials revisions, and preparation of recurring work. When new priorities arise, the associate must be able to shift focus quickly while maintaining control of existing workstreams.
This position is initially designed as a temporary assignment, with potential for conversion to a regular full-time role in Q1 2027 based on performance and mutual fit. Conversion is not guaranteed.
The Operations Associate will report to TIGs Chief of Staff (CoS).

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including polished communication through Microsoft Teams and Outlook, with the ability to summarize information clearly and keep the CoS informed daily
Bachelors degree from an accredited 4-year institution
Experience in business operations, consulting operations, professional services
Experience in life sciences, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology consulting

Experience handling financial reporting or operational data in Excel

Familiarity with Workday, particularly the Talent and Absence modules. Workday experience is also a strong plus but is not required

rows.description:
Program Manager
US - Remote
Description
The Marketing team drives preference and everyday usage for consumer products through full-channel marketing to build cultural relevance and accelerate business results. We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to bridge the gap between our marketing channel portfolio, both in-app and off-platform, and our marketing and product teams. This Program Manager will be a key operational partner and the primary liaison between Channel Foundations, Marketing, and Product teams, leading GTM planning, editorial calendars, and integrated campaign rollouts.
The ideal candidate has a demonstrated ability to lead effective cross-functional processes for managing marketing calendars and campaigns, along with the right blend of brand and product knowledge to drive execution end-to-end. Excellent communication skills and comfort with ambiguity are essential. This person must be able to align teams around a strategic north star in a highly cross-functional, fast-moving environment.
Responsibilities
Build and maintain marketing editorial and GTM calendars across Product Marketing, Brand, Social, Communications, Creator Marketing, and Product teams.
Oversee end-to-end execution of 360 marketing campaigns, ensuring stakeholders remain on track with commitments while identifying opportunities to improve processes, increase scalability, and reduce time-to-launch.
Own and optimize team processes, workflows, and guidelines for leveraging owned, shared, and paid channels in partnership with marketing stakeholders, as well as creative development efforts in coordination with Brand Operations, Legal, and Policy teams.
Manage day-to-day relationships with internal and external stakeholders, proactively driving alignment on priorities, key milestones, action items, and project timelines.
Lead execution and documentation of campaign deliverables from kickoff through launch and reporting, including workback schedules, technical requirements, status tracking, and stakeholder communications.
Plan and facilitate creative workshops with cross-functional teams and agency partners to define creative approaches for key marketing initiatives and campaign moments.
Qualifications
10+ years of experience in B2C program management or a related discipline within consumer technology.
Detail-oriented with experience managing multiple complex projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
Experience leading project plans across marketing, brand, design, product, and engineering organizations.
Experience building, identifying, and/or maintaining measurement systems in partnership with data scientists and analytics teams.
Impact-oriented with experience using data, A/B testing, and performance reporting to inform decisions.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate business results and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels.
Proven ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

rows.title: ServiceNow / AI Business Analyst
rows.description:
ServiceNow AI Business Analyst - 100% Remote, Fortune 100 Customer
Candidates must be eligible to work W2 without sponsorship.
Job Description
This fully remote
Senior
ServiceNow AI Business Analyst role supports a large-scale ServiceNow AI Service Management transformation. You will partner closely with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, developers, process owners, and AI teams to identify, define, and translate complex business needs into well-structured, AI-enabled ServiceNow use cases and requirements. The role combines deep ServiceNow ITSM expertise with advanced business analysis skills and hands-on experience with ServiceNow AI capabilities, particularly Now Assist, to design solutions that can be configured, tested, governed, and measured effectively.
Responsibilities
Lead and facilitate complex discovery sessions and requirements workshops with business and technology stakeholders to identify opportunities to apply AI within the ServiceNow platform.
Translate high-level business requests and problems into clearly structured AI use cases, functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and detailed process and workflow diagrams.
Develop and maintain a well-organized backlog of AI-enabled ServiceNow work items, ensuring each item includes clear business value, requirements, and acceptance criteria.
Ask targeted AI-specific discovery questions to clarify business objectives, such as what problem is being solved, who will consume AI-generated outputs, and what information or knowledge the AI should use.
Define the decisions AI can assist with versus those it should make or execute autonomously, and identify where human review or approval is required within AI-enabled workflows.
Establish clear definitions of acceptable AI responses and design appropriate handling paths for scenarios where the AI is uncertain, incorrect, or unable to provide an answer.
Identify and document data, privacy, security, and access restrictions that apply to AI use cases, ensuring alignment with enterprise policies and compliance requirements.
Collaborate with Product Owners, ServiceNow Architects, Developers, ITSM process owners, data teams, and business stakeholders to refine and validate AI-enabled requirements and designs.
Evaluate incoming requests for feasibility, business value, user impact, dependencies, risks, and organizational readiness, and provide recommendations on prioritization and approach.
Challenge and refine stakeholder requests to distinguish where AI adds real value versus where traditional workflow automation or other solutions are more appropriate.
Support the design of AI-enabled ServiceNow solutions so they can be effectively configured, tested, governed, and measured for performance and business impact.
Define metrics and measurement approaches to assess whether AI capabilities are delivering the expected value and contributing to improved service management outcomes.
Contribute to continuous improvement of ServiceNow ITSM and AI practices by sharing insights from discovery sessions, requirements analysis, and solution performance.
Ensure that ServiceNow AI initiatives align with established Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge Management, and Service Catalog processes.
Essential Skills
5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst,
Senior
Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or in a similar role supporting enterprise technology initiatives.
Strong hands-on experience working within the ServiceNow ecosystem.
Deep understanding of ServiceNow IT Service Management (ITSM), including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge Management, and Service Catalog processes.
Proven experience supporting ServiceNow AI initiatives such as Now Assist, Virtual Agent, AI Search, Predictive Intelligence, Generative AI, or comparable AI-enabled ServiceNow capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to facilitate complex stakeholder discovery and requirements workshops across business and technology teams.
Strong experience converting business needs into user stories, functional requirements, acceptance criteria, process and workflow diagrams, use cases, and backlog items.
Solid understanding of Generative AI and enterprise AI concepts, particularly the considerations that differ from traditional workflow automation.
Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with Product Owners, ServiceNow Architects, Developers, ITSM process owners, data teams, and business stakeholders.
Experience with business analysis in the context of service management and AI projects, including requirements gathering and business requirements definition.
Ability to critically evaluate AI-related requests for feasibility, business value, user impact, dependencies, risks, and organizational readiness.
Additional Skills and Qualifications
Hands-on experience with ServiceNow AI capabilities, with particular emphasis on Now Assist.
Exposure to AI-driven tools and concepts such as Virtual Agent, Control Tower, Copilot, ChatGPT, and similar AI technologies.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to challenge assumptions and refine stakeholder ideas into implementable solutions.
Experience working in Agile environments, including managing and prioritizing backlogs and writing high-quality user stories.
Ability to ask targeted, AI-specific discovery questions to clarify business problems, data requirements, user interactions, and governance needs.
Comfort operating in a remote, cross-functional, enterprise technology environment.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical and AI concepts into clear, business-focused language.

This resource will manage Agile teams supporting product development initiatives and roadmap execution while driving project delivery across engineering, QA, database administration, product ownership, and business stakeholders. The ideal candidate will bring a blend of traditional project management expertise, Agile delivery leadership, and practical experience utilizing AI-powered productivity and automation tools to improve delivery outcomes.
The Project Manager will oversee initiatives ranging from roadmap planning through release execution, breaking strategic initiatives into sprint-level deliverables while managing dependencies, risks, stakeholder communications, and reporting requirements.
Manage projects from initiation through delivery across multiple Agile teams.
Lead cross-functional teams including Engineering, QA, Product Owners, DBAs, and Operations.
Build and maintain project roadmaps, release plans, sprint deliverables, milestones, and dependencies.
Track and manage project scope, risks, issues, action items, and resource dependencies.
Facilitate Agile ceremonies and ensure successful sprint execution.
Coordinate delivery efforts across 1-3 Agile squads (approximately 12-20 team members).
Produce weekly, bi-weekly, quarterly, and executive-level project reporting.
Participate in recurring stakeholder reviews and PM leadership meetings.

rows.title: Operations Specialist
rows.description:
Description
We are seeking a highly organized, analytical, and proactive Operations Associate to help drive the firms day-to-day operating rhythm and create meaningful capacity for the Chief of Staff.
This person will monitor the pulse of the organization. They will own recurring operational workflows, maintain accurate staffing and business data, monitor cross-departmental activity, note key business priorities, and provide the Chief of Staff with clear, concise summaries of what is happening across the organization. The role will also support one-off analyses, requests, and operational priorities as they arise.
This is an analytical operations role, not a traditional executive assistant position, with potential to grow into a critical part of the business. The successful candidate will be comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy, managing competing priorities, responding quickly, and making progress without waiting for constant direction. They will be expected to close lingering loops through dedicated follow-up with appropriate stakeholders, identify issues before they become problems, and keep the Chief of Staff appropriately informed, escalating when necessary.
The workload will vary from day to day. During quieter periods, the Operations Associate will be expected to use time productively for documentation in our software systems, data cleanup in Excel, process improvement internally, training materials revisions, and preparation of recurring work. When new priorities arise, the associate must be able to shift focus quickly while maintaining control of existing workstreams.
This position is initially designed as a temporary assignment, with potential for conversion to a regular full-time role in Q1 2027 based on performance and mutual fit. Conversion is not guaranteed.
The Operations Associate will report to TIGs Chief of Staff (CoS).

rows.description:
Description
Role Overview
The Product Immersion & Testing Team within Business Product Marketing (BPM) is seeking a Program Manager who is passionate about customer insights, testing, launching, and scaling newest business and marketing solutions. We accelerate business growth and product development by integrating the voice of the customer into our product marketing flywheel, leveraging insights to drive impactful strategies and outcomes.
As an ideal candidate, you are a strategic thinker and a self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. You have a proven track record of managing complex projects, collaborating across Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, Product Marketing, and leveraging customer insights and data analysis to inform decisions. Your expertise in business tools (e.g., Ads Manager), marketing, and measurement is unmatched, and you excel at distilling complex ideas into actionable insights.
Responsibilities
Lead Product Immersion & Testing Initiatives: Manage, monitor, and recruit for product tests (alpha, beta, GA) and immersions, driving delivery of multiple projects as the main point of contact for Product, Sales, and Data Science.
Planning and Strategy: Define goals, identify clients, coordinate logistics, and compile key information into briefs for immersion and testing projects.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work extensively with Product Managers, Product Marketing, Data Science, Engineering, and User Research to scope immersion and test design/requirements, manage logistics, and surface insights to influence for product and business outcomes (product changes, roadmap impact).
Communication: Effectively communicate relevant insights and findings to cross-functional teams, influencing roadmap prioritization and developing solutions to fix problems at scale.
Process Improvement: Inform, influence, and execute new processes based on analysis and impact metrics to improve efficiency and quality of support.
Issue Resolution: Troubleshoot and problem-solve issues (bugs, feature requests, product confusions) during testing and immersions, utilizing escalation paths and updating stakeholders.
Travel: Support in-market experiences, with up to 20% travel (including international).

Design, build, and maintain a centralized knowledge ecosystem serving Sales, Customer Care, Installation, Product,

Write, edit, and maintain SOPs, technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, and customer-support content in a
clear, consistent, searchable, and accessible format.
Build decision trees and guided workflows within the knowledge base to help advisors navigate troubleshooting and
call-handling scenarios step by step.
Establish and operate a formal review and governance process for all SOPs and documentation, including scheduled

rows.title: Cloud & Infrastructure Project Manager (Top Secret Clearance Required)
rows.description:
Remote | 20% Travel | Active Top Secret Clearance Required
We are seeking a Project Manager with strong technical infrastructure and cloud migration experience to support a large-scale Department of Defense modernization program. This role will lead complex workload and virtual machine migrations from legacy on-premises environments into modern private and public cloud architectures.
This is not a traditional functional PM role. We are looking for someone who understands the technical side of infrastructure migrations and can effectively manage migration factories, migration waves, dependencies, schedules, engineering teams, and production cutovers.
The position is primarily remote with approximately 20% travel to customer locations.
What Youll Do
Lead infrastructure migration efforts from initial planning through successful production cutover
Manage workload and virtual machine (VM) migrations across large enterprise environments
Coordinate migrations from on-premises infrastructure to private and/or public cloud environments
Develop and manage migration waves, including wave planning, sequencing, schedules, dependencies, risks, and milestones
Work closely with engineering, architecture, operations, and customer stakeholders to ensure migration readiness
Drive coordination across multiple technical teams during migration execution and cutover activities
Identify migration risks, blockers, and dependencies and drive them to resolution
Provide clear status reporting and executive-level communication around schedules, risks, and migration progress
Serve as the primary Project Manager for assigned migrations through successful transition
Coordinate handoff to managed services and operations teams once workloads have been migrated and stabilized
Required Qualifications
Active Top Secret clearance
Demonstrated experience leading workload migrations
Experience managing virtual machine (VM) migrations
Strong experience with on-premises-to-cloud migrations
Experience working with private cloud and/or public cloud environments
Hands-on project leadership experience with Migration Factory methodologies
Experience developing and executing migration waves / wave plans
Background
supporting large-scale infrastructure modernization, data center transformation, virtualization, or cloud migration programs
Strong understanding of migration concepts, terminology, dependencies, and production cutover processes
Ability to communicate effectively with both highly technical engineering teams and program/customer leadership
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Project, and other project management tools
Ability to travel approximately 20%
Preferred Qualifications
PMP certification or other recognized project/program management certification
Experience supporting Department of Defense or other Federal Government environments
Experience with enterprise virtualization technologies
Experience supporting large, complex data center or cloud transformation initiatives
Familiarity with managed services operating models and transitioning migrated workloads into steady-state operations
Why This Opportunity?
This role provides the opportunity to contribute to one of the largest infrastructure modernization efforts within the Department of Defense. Youll be working at the intersection of program management, infrastructure engineering, virtualization, and cloud transformation.
Youll have the opportunity to:
Influence enterprise-scale migration strategy
Work alongside
senior
cloud, virtualization, infrastructure, and migration engineers
Gain exposure to next-generation private and public cloud technologies
Support the modernization of mission-critical government infrastructure
Play a highly visible role within a long-term DoD transformation program
Help move large enterprise environments away from legacy infrastructure toward more scalable, resilient architectures
Work Environment
Primarily remote
Approximately 20% travel
Department of Defense environment
Collaborative engineering and migration team
Large-scale, mission-critical infrastructure modernization program

Job Description
Job Summary:
Under limited supervision, the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Quality Control AML Analyst is responsible for
reviewing the quality and accuracy of the Client Intelligence Unit (CIU) and Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU). This role
involves a critical attention to detail and will also be accountable for generating periodic reports (metrics) that will be
utilized by the AML  Management team in order to analyze quality trends and patterns. May handle projects of

transactional analysis.

and/or banking industrys regulatory requirements.

Maintain and update written procedures for assigned job responsibilities.
Function as a subject matter expert on AML-related issues and provide mentoring as needed.
