rows.title: Treasury Business Analyst
rows.description:
TEKsystems is currently looking for a Treasury Business Analyst for a long term remote contract.
This individual will serve as a key liaison between Treasury business stakeholders and technology, data, QA/testing, and delivery teams.
The ideal candidate brings hands-on Treasury domain experience along with strong core Business Analyst capabilities. This person must be comfortable taking complex business needs, breaking them down into actionable requirements and user stories, and maintaining clear traceability from the original business objective through design, development, testing, and implementation.
This is not a generalist BA role. Candidates should understand how Treasury functions operate within a large, complex, regulated banking environment.
Key Responsibilities
1. Strategy & Requirements Gathering
Partner directly with Treasury stakeholders to understand business objectives, current-state processes, pain points, regulatory considerations, and technology needs.
Lead requirements elicitation sessions, workshops, interviews, and working sessions with business and technical stakeholders.
Translate Treasury business needs into clear functional and non-functional requirements.
Analyze current-state and future-state processes and identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and downstream impacts.
Challenge and clarify requirements to ensure the team is solving the underlying business problem rather than simply documenting requests.
Facilitate alignment between Treasury, technology, data, architecture, operations, and risk/control stakeholders.
Support requirement prioritization and help establish acceptance criteria and measurable business outcomes.
2. Requirements Packaging & User Stories
Decompose broad business requirements and epics into well-defined features and user stories that technology teams can execute against.
Candidates must be able to "rock crush" large, complex requirements, breaking them into smaller, testable, development-ready stories without losing the original business intent.
Write detailed user stories with appropriate acceptance criteria, business rules, data requirements, dependencies, assumptions, and exception scenarios.
Partner with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, developers, architects, and QA teams during backlog refinement and sprint planning.
Ensure stories meet appropriate Definition of Ready standards before entering development.
Clarify requirements throughout the development lifecycle and quickly resolve ambiguity or gaps identified by delivery teams.
Experience working within Agile/Scrum environments and tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps is strongly preferred.
3. Traceability & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Establish and maintain end-to-end requirements traceability from business objectives and requirements through user stories, technical solutions, data requirements, test cases, defects, and final implementation.
Maintain a clear Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) or equivalent traceability framework.
Collaborate closely with:
Treasury/business stakeholders
Application development and engineering teams
Solution and enterprise architects
Data analysts and data engineering teams
QA and UAT teams
Risk, controls, compliance, and operations teams
Partner with data teams to identify source-to-target requirements, data mappings, transformations, business rules, data quality requirements, and reconciliation needs.
Work with testers to ensure test scenarios and test cases appropriately cover documented business and functional requirements.
Participate in defect triage to determine whether issues are related to requirements, data, technology implementation, or testing.
Ensure changes to requirements are reflected throughout downstream artifacts to maintain traceability.
Treasury Domain Experience
Candidates must have prior experience working within Treasury or Treasury Technology at a large bank or financial institution.
Relevant experience may include exposure to areas such as:
Liquidity management and liquidity risk
Cash and funding management
Balance sheet management
Asset Liability Management (ALM)
Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP)
Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book (IRRBB)
Capital and liquidity reporting
Treasury data and reporting
Cash-flow forecasting
Funding and deposit analytics
Treasury risk and controls
Regulatory liquidity requirements such as LCR and NSFR
Treasury management systems and related data platforms
The BA does not need to be a Treasury quant, but must have enough domain knowledge to speak the language of Treasury stakeholders, understand the business processes and data, and translate those needs effectively for technology teams.
Required Qualifications
5+ years of Business Analyst experience within banking or financial services.
Demonstrated experience supporting Treasury or Treasury Technology initiatives.
Strong requirements elicitation, documentation, and analysis skills.
Demonstrated ability to break complex business requirements into clear, granular user stories and acceptance criteria.
Strong experience with requirements traceability across business, technology, data, and testing.
Experience working directly with developers, architects, data teams, QA/testers, Product Owners, and business stakeholders.
Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
Experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or comparable requirements/delivery tools.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to operate effectively in a large, highly matrixed and regulated banking environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting enterprise Treasury transformation or modernization programs.
Experience with Treasury data, reporting, regulatory, liquidity, ALM, or funding initiatives.
SQL or strong data-analysis skills.
Experience creating process flows, data mappings, business rules, and RTMs.
Familiarity with Treasury platforms such as Kyriba, FIS Quantum, Finastra, Murex, Calypso, or similar platforms is beneficial but not required.

Description
The Wireless Implementation Team is seeking an experienced Project Manager to support wireless small cell deployment projects. This individual will oversee all pre-construction activities from candidate selection through site acquisition, compliance, zoning, permitting, and Real Estate Complete milestones before handoff to the construction team.
The Project Manager will be responsible for managing large portfolios of wireless deployment projects, coordinating third-party vendors, maintaining customer databases, preparing weekly status reporting, leading deployment meetings, and providing project updates to internal leadership, customers, and sales teams.
The role interacts regularly with major wireless carriers including Verizon, AT&T, and T-Mobile and requires strong communication skills, organization, and the ability to manage competing priorities and risks. The successful candidate will understand the wireless site development lifecycle and be comfortable engaging with jurisdictions, utility providers, regulatory teams, engineering partners, and internal stakeholders.

Description
Seeking an experienced Epic Project Manager to lead a multi-practice Community Connect offboarding initiative. This individual will be responsible for overseeing the separation of four affiliated physician practices from Epic, coordinating cross-functional teams, managing vendor communications, and ensuring successful completion of all operational, technical, regulatory, and application-related activities.

Project Leadership & Governance
Lead the overall planning, execution, and delivery of the Community Connect offboarding program.

rows.title: Implementation Project Manager
rows.description:
To Apply for this Job Click Here
Project Manager II – Implementation Project Manager
Location: Remote within Wisconsin
Employment Type: Contract
Anticipated Start: Late November 2026
Initial Duration: Through June 30, 2027, with potential for extension
Schedule: Must be available during core Central Time business hours
Position Overview
The Wisconsin Department of Children and Families (DCF) is seeking an experienced Implementation Project Manager to support a large-scale modernization initiative focused on implementing a new case management system.
This position will oversee and coordinate implementation activities leading up to and throughout pilot and system rollout. The Implementation Project Manager will work across project management, organizational change management (OCM), training, technical teams, implementation leadership, external vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure the organization is prepared for each stage of implementation.
This role is particularly focused on implementation planning, organizational readiness, stakeholder coordination, communications, training readiness, pilot execution, and phased system rollout. The Project Manager will oversee day-to-day implementation activities, track progress and issues, coordinate dependencies across teams, and help ensure the organization is prepared to transition from the existing environment to the modernized system.
Key Responsibilities
* Develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive implementation and communication plans for a large-scale system modernization initiative.
* Oversee implementation activities leading up to and during pilot, go-live, and phased regional system rollouts.
* Coordinate functional and technical implementation activities across project teams, vendors, and DCF stakeholders.
* Partner closely with Project Management, Organizational Change Management, Training, and implementation leadership to ensure organizational readiness.
* Track implementation activities, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and overall progress.
* Coordinate with project leadership to resolve implementation issues within required timeframes.
* Provide regular status updates and reporting regarding implementation progress, readiness, risks, and potential issues.
* Develop and maintain acceptance and readiness criteria for major implementation milestones, including:
○ UAT to pilot
○ Pilot to system rollout
○ Subsequent regional rollout phases
* Coordinate state-level activities required to maintain alignment between legacy systems and the modernized system during pilot and rollout.
* Facilitate cross-functional meetings between business, technical, OCM, training, vendor, and project teams.
* Coordinate with implementation vendors to ensure required hardware and software are available prior to scheduled go-live dates.
* Support planning for periods in which legacy and new systems may operate simultaneously.
* Partner with Training and Organizational Change Management teams to confirm required training and communications are completed prior to implementation.
* Ensure project teams and stakeholders are informed of upcoming implementation activities, timelines, dependencies, and responsibilities.
* Coordinate activities related to system rollout, site support, user readiness, user account provisioning, and defect/issue reporting.
* Identify potential implementation challenges and recommend appropriate process, policy, or procedural changes when necessary.
* Build and maintain collaborative relationships with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
Required Qualifications
Candidates should have 11+ years of experience in:
* Project management.
* Developing and implementing project implementation plans and communication plans.
* Building and maintaining collaborative relationships with diverse stakeholder groups.
Candidates should also have demonstrated experience with:
* Large-scale system implementations and organizational transformation initiatives.
* Coordinating complex implementation activities across multiple project teams and stakeholder groups.
* Organizational change, implementation readiness, and training efforts.
* Project leadership and management.
* Managing competing priorities, deadlines, and dependencies.
* Written and verbal communication, including developing and delivering presentations to stakeholders.
* Facilitating cross-functional meetings and driving activities toward implementation milestones.
Preferred Experience
* Experience supporting federal or state government programs.
* Federal Child Support Program experience.
* Experience implementing or modernizing large-scale case management systems.
* Experience working alongside Organizational Change Management, training, technical, and implementation teams.
* Experience supporting phased implementations involving pilot programs and regional rollouts.
Project Environment
This position will support the Child Support Modernization Project, which is implementing a new case management system. The Implementation Project Manager will work with internal and external stakeholders and will be responsible for overseeing and tracking implementation progress, coordinating day-to-day activities, and ensuring teams remain aligned throughout pilot and rollout.
The position requires someone who can operate across both the business and technical sides of an implementation. The individual will not simply maintain a project plan. They will actively coordinate teams, surface and resolve implementation issues, manage readiness activities, and ensure the appropriate pieces are in place for successful go-live and rollout.
Remote Work Requirements
* Candidates must currently reside in Wisconsin or be willing to relocate to Wisconsin within 30 days of the start date at their own expense.
* The position is approximately 90-100% remote, although occasional onsite work may be required with appropriate notice.
* Candidates must be physically located within the United States, and work cannot be performed outside the U.S.
* Candidates must be available during required Central Time business hours.
* The selected candidate will be responsible for providing their own computer equipment, reliable internet connection, camera, and headset for remote work.
* No regular on-call or weekend coverage is required.

rows.description:
Job Title: Security Compliance Analyst
Location: Remote
Duraton: 6 Months Contract
Description
We seek a detail-oriented
Security Compliance Analyst
to provide hands-on administrative and program-management support for Security Compliance.
The person will keep recurring reviews, audits, testing engagements, and customer security requests moving on schedule so Security Compliance specialists can focus on assessment, technical interpretation, and remediation efforts.
The analyst will work with Security Compliance program owners and relevant cross-functional stakeholders under a defined intake and escalation process.
This job will have the following responsibilities:
Third-Party Security Questionnaire intake and response:
Monitor assigned customer security questionnaire and document-request queues and relevant channel requests; acknowledge and categorize requests, identify DRIs and due dates, and route requesters to approved self-service materials where appropriate. Use the team’s questionnaire tool to generate draft responses, then validate them for completeness, accuracy, and consistency with approved security documentation; track DRI input and assemble approved artifacts. Initially, a Security Compliance employee will review the completed responses and approve delivery. After training and demonstrated accuracy, the contractor may independently review and deliver routine questionnaires within an agreed, documented scope. Escalate bespoke questions, uncertain or outdated answers, new security assertions, nonpublic disclosures, blockers, and deadlines to the appropriate Security Compliance employee or team DRI before delivery.
Quarterly Security Operational Reviews:
Maintain the quarter-by-quarter calendar, control/evidence request list, templates, status tracker, evidence links, and follow-up log. Collect evidence from control owners, identify missing or late submissions, prepare review packets and draft administrative portions of the report, and track Security Compliance/PCI DRI review and approval. The Security Compliance reviewer remains responsible for examining evidence, documenting substantive conclusions, and verifying PCI DSS business-as-usual requirements.
Audit and penetration-test logistics:
Maintain audit and test calendars, evidence/request trackers, and action logs; schedule walkthroughs from program-owner-approved attendee and scope lists; coordinate vendor meetings, access requests through approved channels, evidence deadlines, and follow-ups. Keep a clear record of what was requested, provided, reviewed, and still outstanding. Program owners retain audit scope, firm selection, SOW approval, findings, and responses.
Operational reporting and handoff:
Produce a concise weekly view of open requests, aged items, upcoming milestones, unresolved decisions, and escalations. Document repeatable playbooks, templates, owners, and evidence locations to enable a clean handoff at contract end.
Qualifications & Requirements:
Experience coordinating security compliance, audits, compliance operations, or customer security questionnaires.
Strong written communication, discretion with confidential information; strong program/project management backgrounds and general security familiarity; organized tracking and follow-through, and comfort coordinating across several teams and external parties.
Familiarity with PCI DSS, SOC1/2, and/or ISO 27001, audit evidence, and security questionnaires is preferred, but not required.
The role requires reliable execution, sound escalation judgment, and coordination with employee owners for compliance determinations.
Decision and access boundaries:
Security Compliance employees own control interpretation, evidence acceptance, substantive review findings, new customer-facing security assertions, non-routine disclosure decisions, and attestations. Following training and authorization, the contractor may review and deliver routine questionnaire responses within the agreed scope. Employee DRIs review exceptions before delivery. client's employees own purchase orders and vendor-invoice approvals.

An Integrated Marketer: You understand how brand campaigns come together across channels and how different marketing activities contribute to awareness, consideration, and business outcomes.
An Exceptional Project Manager: You can turn complex marketing initiatives into clear plans, manage multiple moving pieces, and keep teams aligned without losing sight of the bigger picture.

rows.description:
Title: Sr. Compliance Manager - Remote
Salary :$90k - $110K
Day-to-Day Responsibilities
Regulatory Compliance: Manage and support environmental compliance programs for landfill and solid waste facilities, ensuring adherence to California LMR, NSPS, NESHAP, and applicable air quality permit requirements.
Data Analysis: Review, interpret, and validate landfill gas monitoring data, wellfield data, SEM results, and air emissions datasets to identify compliance risks, deviations, and corrective actions.
Compliance Reporting: Prepare, review, and finalize quarterly and annual compliance reports, monitoring summaries, deviation analyses, and regulatory submissions.
Air Quality Permitting: Lead air permit applications, renewals, and modifications, including emissions calculations, regulatory applicability assessments, and compliance demonstrations.
Multi-Site Compliance: Manage compliance data, reporting deadlines, and regulatory requirements across multiple landfill facilities and client accounts.
Process Improvement: Develop and maintain standardized reporting templates, Excel trackers, compliance tools, and quality control procedures.
Field Coordination: Work closely with field technicians, operations teams, and engineers to ensure monitoring activities, testing protocols, and landfill gas systems meet regulatory requirements.
Client & Agency Communication: Support regulatory inspections, agency inquiries, audits, and client compliance discussions.
Technical Leadership: Provide technical guidance to Project Managers and junior staff, review deliverables, and support overall project quality and compliance.
Must Haves
5+ years of experience in environmental science, air quality, regulatory compliance, or a related technical field.
Strong knowledge of landfill and solid waste air quality regulations, including California LMR, NSPS, NESHAP, and applicable permit requirements.
Experience preparing and reviewing air quality permits, emissions calculations, regulatory reports, and compliance submissions.
Experience analyzing environmental monitoring data, including landfill gas (LFG) data, Surface Emissions Monitoring (SEM) results, and air emissions datasets.
Familiarity with landfill gas collection and control systems  and associated monitoring requirements.
Strong technical writing skills, particularly for regulatory reports, permit applications, and agency submissions.
Advanced proficiency for data analysis, compliance tracking, and reporting.
Ability to independently manage multiple projects, reporting deadlines, and competing priorities in a remote environment.
Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, or a related field.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with clients, regulatory agencies, engineers, and field staff.
Valid driver's license and willingness to travel occasionally.
This is a direct hire opportunity. The selected candidate will be employed directly by our client. All compensation and benefits, including but not limited to medical insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, and other perks, will be provided by the client in accordance with their internal policies and subject to applicable laws and eligibility requirements.

rows.title: Project Manager, Merchant Services Implementation
rows.description:
Outstanding long-term contract opportunity! A well-known Financial Services Company is looking for a Project Manager in Charlotte, NC (Hybrid).

Our client has been around for over 150 years and is continuously innovating in today's digital age. If you want to work for a company that is not only a household name, but also truly cares about satisfying customers' financial needs and helping people succeed financially, apply today.

Hands-on project management experience, including project planning, status reporting, task tracking, and risk and issue management.
Strong organizational, time-management, and communication skills.
Confidence working with clients and coordinating cross-functional stakeholders.
The ability to manage details and drive progress with limited oversight.
Experience with traditional or waterfall project management approaches.

Experience in merchant services, payments, or a related financial services area.
Exposure to merchant onboarding, payment products, or client implementation.
Familiarity with project tools such as Microsoft Project and Excel.

rows.title: Staff Level Security Engineer/Okta/AWS/Risk
rows.description:
We are seeking a Staff Security Engineer to join an innovative, technology-driven company fully remote, on a full-time basis. This is a high-impact opportunity to help shape and scale the company's security architecture across a modern cloud environment, with a focus on AWS, Okta, cloud security, identity and access management (IAM), security risk management, and enterprise security strategy. The ideal candidate is a senior-level security engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strategic thinking to strengthen security posture, reduce risk, and enable the business to innovate securely.
We're looking for a hands-on technical leader who can think beyond individual tools, connect security decisions to business risk, and build scalable solutions that grow with the organization. You'll have the opportunity to shape cloud security strategy, modernize identity controls, influence architecture decisions, and mentor engineers while remaining close to the technology. If you're excited by solving complex security challenges, owning meaningful projects, and having a voice in the company's long-term security direction, this role offers the opportunity to make a measurable impact.
Required Skills & Experience
Extensive experience in security engineering, cloud security, or enterprise security architecture.
Strong hands-on experience securing AWS environments, including IAM, networking, logging, encryption, and security monitoring.
Deep knowledge of Okta, including SSO, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, MFA, lifecycle management, and identity governance.
Strong understanding of identity and access management, least-privilege principles, privileged access, and Zero Trust security.
Experience conducting security risk assessments, identifying control gaps, and developing risk mitigation strategies.
Knowledge of security frameworks and controls, such as NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, CIS Benchmarks, and SOC 2.
Experience with cloud security posture management, vulnerability management, threat modeling, and incident response.
Ability to partner cross-functionally with engineering, infrastructure, IT, compliance, and executive stakeholders.
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical risks into actionable business recommendations.
Desired Skills & Experience
Experience in a Staff, Principal, or senior technical leadership role.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and security automation.
Experience with SIEM platforms, centralized logging, detection engineering, and security observability.
Knowledge of container security, Kubernetes, and modern application security practices.
Experience implementing security controls within CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps workflows.
Familiarity with endpoint detection and response (EDR), secrets management, and data protection technologies.
Experience supporting security audits, regulatory compliance, and enterprise risk management programs.
Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, CISSP, CCSP, or Okta certifications.
What You Will Be Doing Tech Breakdown
40% AWS & Cloud Security — Secure cloud infrastructure, improve configurations, implement guardrails, and strengthen cloud security architecture.
25% Identity & Access Management — Enhance Okta, SSO, MFA, privileged access, identity lifecycle controls, and Zero Trust capabilities.
20% Security Risk & Architecture — Conduct risk assessments, develop mitigation plans, perform threat modeling, and influence security design decisions.
15% Security Engineering & Automation — Build automation, improve monitoring and detection, integrate security into engineering workflows, and reduce operational risk.
Daily Responsibilities
40% Hands-On Engineering — Design, implement, and improve security controls across AWS, Okta, and the broader enterprise environment.
30% Architecture & Risk Leadership — Drive security initiatives, assess emerging risks, establish technical standards, and guide remediation priorities.
20% Team Collaboration — Partner with engineering, IT, infrastructure, compliance, and leadership to embed security into day-to-day operations.
10% Mentorship & Strategic Planning — Mentor engineers, influence technical direction, and help define the organization's evolving security roadmap.
The Offer
Competitive base salary commensurate with experience.
Bonus eligible.
Opportunity to influence enterprise security strategy and architecture.
High degree of ownership, autonomy, and technical leadership.
Collaborative environment with opportunities for professional growth and continued learning.
Work-life balance and flexibility, depending on business and team needs.
You Will Receive the Following Benefits
Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Paid vacation and time off.
Stock options or equity participation, subject to company eligibility and plan terms.
Opportunities for professional development and relevant certifications.
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis now and in the future.
